3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]

Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: The New "Trait" System Gives Equipment a Random Effect!
notes.content:
Introducing the new 'Trait' system, where monster drops now have a chance to come with a random ability.
Additionally, a "Trait Transfer" feature has been added, allowing the trait on one piece of equipment to be transferred to another.

Trait
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/65ff1c6833aedd72d1c88613f6e1e0b775ef99bf.png
Equipment dropped by monsters may now come with a "trait".

A "trait" may grant an effect that is the same as that on normal equipment, or a completely different effect. 
Players with any active 30-Day Ticket (Bag Expansion/Standard Ticket/Leveling Ticket) will have their name registered when equipment receives a Tier 3 or higher tier trait.

*Additional gear and special gear will not have a trait.

Equipment Dropped by Field Monsters
・Up to Tier 4 traits can be obtained from field monsters (including bosses).
・Tier 4 traits are available from monsters of level 100 or higher.

Equipment Dropped from Boss Battles
The maximum tier depends on the difficulty level selected.
[table][tr][th]Difficulty[/th][th]The maximum tier[/th][/tr][tr][td]Easy[/td][td]Up to Tier 1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal[/td][td]Up to Tier 2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hard[/td][td]Up to Tier 3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Nightmare[/td][td]Tier 4 is included for Lv100 and above.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ultimate[/td][td]Tier 5 is included for Lv200 and above.[/td][/tr][/table]

Equipment from Treasure Chests and Exchanges
Depending on the equipment obtained, it may have a trait up to Tier 4.

Trait Transfer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6f475c502984ef94ef3d5eccdc12d2c5d8077ab7.png
"Trait Transfer" has been added. You can use Spinas to transfer a trait to another piece of equipment at the blacksmith.
You can use this feature from Blacksmith > Customize Equipment > Trait Transfer.

The success rate of trait transfer is 100% when transferring a trait to the same item; however, it is 10% lower when transferring to a different item.

*Trait transfer between different equipment types, for example from a one-handed sword to a bow, is not possible.

Use "Radiant Chance" to Increase Your Trait Transfer Success Rate!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6be570f2f47cf82697d2ed84ec357b334b685325.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a7580a82f6e40206be89fe8b0894d7998b7545ee.png[/td][/tr][/table]
When a trait transfer fails, the trait "Radiant Chance Lv1" is granted, increasing the success rate of the next transfer by 10%.
Failing trait transfer consecutively can increase the level of "Radiant Chance", potentially reaching up to Lv9.

"Radiant Chance" can also be transferred to another piece of equipment.
Grant leveled-up "Radiant Chance" to the equipment to increase trait transfer success!

*If the trait on the equipment used as material is "Radiant Chance" and the transfer fails, then its level will drop to 1.
*When performing a transfer between items with "Radiant Chance", the success rates are combined, but the level will only increase by 1.

Use "Magic Hammer" to Raise the Level of "Radiant Chance"!
"Magic Hammer" can be used to intentionally make a transfer fail (0% success) to raise the level of "Radiant Chance".
"Magic Hammer" decreases the success rate differently depending on its grade, and higher-grade hammers allow greater level increases in "Radiant Chance".

[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Success Rate Decrease per Item[/th][th]"Radiant Chance" Level Increase[/th][/tr][tr][td]Magic Hammer[/td][td]-10%[/td][td]The level increases by 1 each time.
*Same as usual tranfer[/td][/tr][tr][td]Super Magic Hammer[/td][td]-30%[/td][td]The level increases by 2.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hyper Magic Hammer[/td][td]-70%[/td][td]The level increases by 3.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Orb - Magic Hammer[/td][td]-100%[/td][td]The level increases by 3.[/td][/tr][/table]

*When performing a transfer with "Magic Hammers" of different grades, the level increase will be a random value between the lowest and highest values of the hammers used.
Ex: Using 1 "Magic Hammer" + 1 "Super Magic Hammer" will randomly increase the level of "Radiant Chance" by 1 or 2.

Notes
*In-game description will be adjusted at a later date.

notes.title: Application Update
notes.content:
We would like to announce the update for the app.
For details, please check the following.

Maintenance Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/157ad990740aed07cd35360a8dbd4878e214ef16.png

 Major Update with New Story Missions & New Maps!
 New Recipes Addition.
 Few updates on the security system.


Skill Adjustments.
Draconic Charge

 Improved the base damage when it is activated after charging.
 Increased the skill's second hit damage boost from 0 to a max of 300.


Infinite Dimension

 AGI now affects power.


Almighty Wield

 When taking damage, Godspeed Wield used to only lose its effect by one stage, however, due to the active effect added in a later update, it had become almost meaningless. Therefore, the skill's effect has been revised.
Now you may gain invincibility (based on AGI) when taking damage. This effect may trigger once every 10 seconds.
A passive effect that boosts the physical damage of Halberd skills has also been added.


Lunar Misfortune

 Improved power boost by DEX.


Twin Buster Blade

 Added a guaranteed critical hit effect to the second hit of the AoE attack.


Sting Blade

 When using dual swords, the attack recovery of the second hit can now be canceled with an Evasion.


Union Sword

 Effects that increase the next skill's action speed or allow instant activation now apply to the derived skill. 


The following improvements have been applied.

 Improved the effect of heavy armor remodelling.


Added the following advantages to body armor that has been remodeled to heavy.

 Flinch resistance +100%
 Stun duration -1 second
 Fractional Damage reduction (depending on refinement value)
 Knock Back distance -50%



 Added a special ability to dropped items.


The following issues have been fixed.

 Under certain conditions, UI display problem occurs.
 Minor bug fixes.


Notes
* If you cannot start the game, please add the game to the exclusion list of your security software.
For details on how to add it to the exclusion list, please refer to the website of the security software you are using.

Hunt "Silver Coryn" and Get Dyed Equipment!

During the campaign period, "Silver Coryn" will appear in "Rakau Plains", "Yorl Highlands", "Darkanon Plain", "Wanderers' Plains", "Tolbas Grassland" and "???".

Special "Body Armor" or "Additional Gear" that can be used to dye your equipment through synthesis may drop if you succeed in defeating it.

Let's Make Use of the EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a60d20df6b4fd79816080579cc9b76b3d9feee21.png
[Menu > Character > Skills > Use EX Skills > Alchemy Skills]

The EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills will be unlocked if "Technical Synthesis I" Lv1 or higher has been acquired.

・The option to "Save Color" will only be shown when the equipment has color info.
Multiple colors can be selected and saved.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.
Please note that if the success rate is low, the equipment may not be colored although the saved color has been used.

Furthermore, the result of the transmutation will be the initial(default) equipment for each equipment type.

*The equipment which color is fetched will be lost including the crysta.
*Depending on the value of the Personal Stat "LUK", it may not generate anything when it fails.
The equipment used as material will be returned.
*The option to "Save Color" will not be shown when the equipment is locked, equipped or only has the color that has reached the maximum save limit.
*Colors will be saved per equipment.
*The maximum limit of the same color that can be saved is 99 for each "Part A/ Part B/ Part C" for each type of equipment.
*The color is saved per account.
*If the status of "Technical Synthesis I" becomes "Not Acquired Yet" due to "Skill Tree Reset", the EX Skill "Color Saving" will become unavailable. However, the colors you have saved will not be lost.
*If there is an active 30-Day Ticket, the character name will be added to the transmuted equipment.

Notes
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Tips: How to Capture More Easily
You can capture monsters more easily by weakening them before starting capture.
Try attacking the monsters and inflict status ailments.

Tips: Captured Monsters Are Tradable!
The captured monsters are tradable with other players or via Consignment before releasing them on your land.
If you're having a hard time capturing monsters with the nature or type you like, you might want to get them by trading!

During the Taste of Autumn Event, "Persimmon Coryn" will appear in "Rakau Plains", "Yorl Highlands", "Darkanon Plain", "Wanderers' Plains", "Tolbas Grassland" and "???".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a60d20df6b4fd79816080579cc9b76b3d9feee21.png
[Menu > Character > Skills > Use EX Skills > Alchemy Skills]

The EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills will be unlocked if "Technical Synthesis I" Lv1 or higher has been acquired.

・The option to "Save Color" will only be shown when the equipment has color info.
Multiple colors can be selected and saved.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.
Please note that if the success rate is low, the equipment may not be colored although the saved color has been used.

Furthermore, the result of the transmutation will be the initial(default) equipment for each equipment type.

*The equipment which color is fetched will be lost including the crysta.
*Depending on the value of the Personal Stat "LUK", it may not generate anything when it fails.
The equipment used as material will be returned.
*The option to "Save Color" will not be shown when the equipment is locked, equipped or only has the color that has reached the maximum save limit.
*Colors will be saved per equipment.
*The maximum limit of the same color that can be saved is 99 for each "Part A/ Part B/ Part C" for each type of equipment.
*The color is saved per account.
*If the status of "Technical Synthesis I" becomes "Not Acquired Yet" due to "Skill Tree Reset", the EX Skill "Color Saving" will become unavailable. However, the colors you have saved will not be lost.
*If there is an active 30-Day Ticket, the character name will be added to the transmuted equipment.

notes.title: New "Sprite Skills" & New Skill Tree "Necromancer Skills" Released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/678812260e48b6f58cf90d127a26ad37ebf88a6b.png
A new skill tree, "Necromancer Skills", has been released following the maintenance on Thursday, August 28, 2025.
New skills have also been added to the "Sprite Skills" tree and adjustments have been made to "Shot Skills".

Take this opportunity to learn new skills!

How to Acquire the Skills
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"　　　　[/td][/tr][/table]
You can acquire the skill tree from the NPC "Lilulu" in the library in "Sofya City" with Spinas when your level meets the requirement.
The skill tree can also be acquired by using the item specified respectively.

You can acquire the Lv1 "Necromancer Skills" tree by using the "Book of Necromancer".
Once your character has reached a certain level, you can acquire Lv2 and higher skills from the library in "Sofya City".

How to Obtain "Book of Necromancer"
You can obtain the "Book of Necromancer" through one of the following methods.

・You have a chance to get it from the World Treasure chests in Story Mission Chapter 14.
・You have a chance to get it from the treasure chests in the Guild Maze starting from 601F. (The deeper you go, the higher the chance is.)
・You may get it as a reward during limited-time events.

Level Requirement for Necromancer Skills
[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]Use item[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv205 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv260 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Necromancer Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Grave Digger[/td][td]Deploys a conceptual graveyard to prepare for necromancy.

Spirit stacks are gained while in the graveyard.
Spirit slowly returns if you leave the graveyard.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Tomb[/td][td]Summons tombstones that spike out of the ground.
Performs a physical attack on the target.
Chance to inflict [Tumble] if VIT is 50 or higher.
Using 3 spirit stacks adds an AoE attack,activating up to 3 times at once.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Phantom Missile[/td][td]Sends forth evil spirits to attack.
Performs a magic attack on the target by consuming spirit stacks (max 10).
Consuming more spirit increases its duration
(number of hits), and its power increases with
each critical hit (physical).[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fine Shovel[/td][td]Gains additional spirit stacks when deploying "Grave Digger" for the first time.

You can now continue gaining spirit stacks even when slightly away from the graveyard.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Skull Shaker[/td][td]Delivers a heavy blow to the top of the head with a staff.
Performs a physical attack to the target.
Chance to inflict [Dizzy].
Each successful hit increases the power and may inflict [Stun] on the target.
The effect resets upon inflicting [Stun].[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blood Siphon[/td][td]Puts a blood-sucking curse on the target.
A portion of the damage dealt is absorbed as HP.
Warning: Low chance to absorb status ailments too.
Chance to inflict [Flinch] if VIT is 50 or higher.
The curse is instantly removed when the target is too far.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skeleton Call[/td][td]Uses 3 spirit stacks to summon a skeleton soldier.
(max 3 on the field)
The soldier performs close-range attack.
It explodes and disappears when caught in an AoE.
Attack power is based on ATK or MATK, whichever is higher.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Harvest[/td][td]Recovers a small amount of HP and MP instantly when a monster is killed.
(activates only once per second.)
A skeleton soldier will be summoned upon recovery
if "Skeleton Call" has been acquired. 
(There can't be more than 3 skeleton soldiers on the field.)[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hazard Strike[/td][td]A versatile staff technique that changes according to the situation.
 A physical attack that can trigger a follow-up move by consuming an
additional 100 MP depending on key input.
Up (high power), Left/Right (damage reduction), Down (backstep)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Soul Stream[/td][td]Unleashes a spiritual particle beam.
Performs a magic attack. Restores MP and raises the chance
to inflict [Lethargy] based on spirit stacks used.
The number of spirit stacks used depends on the 
amount of MP consumed when the skill is activated. (max 20)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Demonic Pact[/td][td]A contract with a demon.
The ability changes based on the amount of MP offered when forming the contract.
Each attack by the demon costs the caster some HP.
Reusing the skill will terminate the contract.
The demon may betray you if things turn bad.
[/td][/tr][tr][td]Opportunist[/td][td]The effect of "Harvest" may still be applied even when a skeleton soldier explodes and disappears.[/td][/tr][/table]

EX Skills for Necromancer Skills
The ability and appearance of the demon from "Demonic Pact" can be changed from Menu > Character > Skills > Use EX Skills.

Pact
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b94627086d62f337112e40ef85d1654d2538e4fc.png
You can adjust the demon's ability by forming a contract.
The number of contracts increases depending on your skill level.

Look
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f7907b3e845a5606fa88337330dd81495b88c51f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0d0a17fb238b8561261c49fd5856bf11bd3de250.png[/td][/tr][/table]
You can change the color and appearance of the demon from Demonic Pact. Only the appearance changes, abilities remain the same.

*You need Orbs to change the appearance.
Changing the color does not consume Orbs.

Sprite Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Ignition[/td][td]Attacks by causing the opponent's mana to burn.
Deals unstable magic damage.
Low chance to inflict [Weaken].
The chance increases with higher DEX and Sprite skill tree level.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Terrawrym[/td][td]Fires a magic projectile that ambush from underground.
A magic projectile is sent crawling along the ground 
toward the target and triggers a small AoE when it hits.
Passes through any targets in the way and inflicts [Stop] on them.
[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Faux Weapon[/td][td]Wields a weapon created with mana.

Targets a single enemy.
The power increases with higher AGI and DEX.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv4
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Slash Reaper[/td][td]Protects yourself from looming danger with magical blades.
If conditions are met, the number of magical
blades increases (up to 99, max 5 deployed at once).
Reusing the skill sends the deployed magical blades to strike the target.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Sprite Upgrade[/td][td]Extends the duration of Auto-Device, Counterforce, Astral Lance, and Stabiliz.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Cursed Altar[/td][td]Devours the soul with a curse.

Puts a "curse" on the target.
If successful, an effect that continuously deals
damage to the target is additionally applied
(damage is reduced against bosses).[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lebenglanz[/td][td]A forbidden technique that reverses the phase of
life that is lost to create explosive power.

Puts a "Life Bomb" on the target.
It explodes and deals damage when the effect ends.[/td][/tr][/table]

Skill Adjustments
The skills below have been adjusted.

■Parabola Cannon
We have reworked the overall skill mechanics since bow and bowgun were rarely used.
The special hit system has been removed. The projectile now heads straight to the target.
The farther it is from the target, the faster it travels. Additionally, a trap will be placed when it is activated with a bow or bowgun.
When placing the trap, holding an arrow key will allow you to perform a rolling move.

■Twin Storm
The effect of Twin Storm now lasts indefinitely until you remove it.
Performing a normal attack during Twin Storm will now accumulate "Overheat".
The more it is accumulated, the more powerful your normal attack gets. Besides, the power of Shot Skills and Hunter Skills will also increase
However, if Overheat builds up too much, the stability of normal attacks will decrease.
Being afflicted with certain status ailments such as Freeze or Stun will remove the effect of Twin Storm and reduce Overheat stacks.

■Vanquisher
This skill performed best when the user ran out of bolts. However, they still had to get close to the target to activate it despite reduced mobility.
This is no longer the case after the rework of Twin Storm. The skill has been adjusted so that consuming 5 Overheat stacks will increase its power and restore MP.
Additionally, the closer you get to the target, the less Guard and Evasion will matter. (Not applicable to event-specific Guard and Evasion)

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:August 22nd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:August 25th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Limited-edition beach maps to enjoy the heat of summer excitement to the fullest and "Diving", a special mini-game that can be played at the beach, have been added through the maintenance on 7/31/2025.

Until: 9/11/2025 before the maintenance

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Explore the Blue Ocean! Let's Dive!
You can challenge the mini-game "Diving" at Saltau's Beach.
Diving is a game to obtain "Fisherman Points" by attacking and defeating various monsters as you move around in the water.
"Gigantic Octopus Battle" and "Free-Diving" are the 2 types of game modes you can play.
The details are as follows.

Gigantic Octopus Battle
In this mode, you team up with your friends to defeat "Gigantic Octopus". You may bring various diving items with you and get many Fisherman Points.

Also, the number of Fisherman Points you get will increase as a result of the drop rate booster effect from your 30-Day Tickets, items, equipment, and etc..

*Please note that the increment will not be applied in Free-Diving mode.

Please note that 1 Stamina from the player who created the room will be used when playing the challenge.
Once the game begins, the Gigantic Octopus will automatically appear after a certain amount of time, so try your best to defeat as many monsters as possible before that to obtain a lot of Fisherman Points!

The room creator in this mode can get more Fisherman Points when the battle against the Gigantic Octopus is completed.

How to Play Gigantic Octopus Battle
You need to either create or join a room created by other players to play Gigantic Octopus Battle.
There are 2 types of rooms, those that can be joined by anyone and those that can only be joined by friends, party or guild members, and acquaintances.
The condition to join the room can also be changed after the diving game has started.

To join a room created by other players, select one from the list. (Up to 15 rooms shown per condition)
The rooms joined by your friends, guild or party members will be shown if you tap "For Acquaintances Only".

Free-Diving
You can swim freely in the ocean in this mode.
You can't bring diving items with you, so you can't get many Fisherman Points. But you can enjoy diving without using any stamina.
You will get used to the diving controls by playing in this mode.

How to Check Diving Stamina
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/fc83f1cbb7cffb3c08b59f7a819f61ddd84134b8.png
At Saltau's Beach, you can always check your Diving Stamina and Diving Items by tapping the button at the center of the screen.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/49ebb7b3d7991db2ba6f145432400f9a2c4ceed8.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/377b57ef419aea5a280451401dee3e156eafc3f0.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Also, you can get more Fisherman Points if you use Diving Items, so just buy from Saltau when you need them.

Diving items are carried over from 2021.

Diving Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7771c8df1291d072a4f0b025a37c308de8211496.png
1. Menu
You can cancel diving, see the names of the participating players, or change the condition of the room you have created.
In Free-Diving mode, the button changes to "Back".

2. AUTO LOCK
It shows the status of AUTO LOCK.
The yellow mark means it is turned ON, while the grey mark means it is turned OFF.
When it is turned ON, the targeted monsters will be attacked.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

3. Oxygen Gauge
It shows the oxygen left.
The oxygen will gradually decrease while diving. Using Dodge or getting attacked by monsters will also reduce it.
Diving ends when it becomes 0.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

4. Fishing Lv
It shows your diving progress.
The level goes up as you defeat more monsters. As the level goes up, monsters that give you more Fisherman Points will appear.
The highest level is 6.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

5. Current Fisherman Points
It shows the Fisherman Points you have obtained during the dive.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

6. Number of Players Participating in the Dive
It shows the total number of players joining the room.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

7. Monsters
The monsters you can attack in the water.
The number of Fisherman Points you can earn depends on the monsters.

8. Change Weapon
The button to switch between harpoon and bowgun.
You can buy arrows from Saltau at the beach house.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

9. Action
Attack near the lock-on cursor with the current weapon.

10. Depth Lock Icon
Tap it to stop going higher or lower from the current depth.

11. Depth
It shows the current depth.

12. Dodge
You will briefly move at high speed if you tap it while moving forward or moving to the left or right.

Notes
*"Fisherman Points" will be deleted through the maintenance after this event ends.
*Stamina is restored over time, but you can also restore it by talking to Saltau and selecting "Eat Food" or using Spinas and Orbs.
However, please note that it will cost you more Spinas each time you restore Stamina with them.
After a certain amount of time, the Spina Cost will go down to the lowest point.
*In Gigantic Octopus Battle mode, the room will automatically be dismissed if the creator decides to cancel diving.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Anybody", only players playing in the same World as the room creator can join.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Acquaintances Only", the creator, participating friends, guild or party members will be shown in the room creator column.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Acquaintances Only", the participants' friends, guild or party members can also join the room.

notes.title: Mini-Game "Mahjong" Added!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a1bd951fab136f6cf4e91aed04da05232366391a.png
A new mini-game where players can enjoy Mahjong together has been added!
Enjoy playing Mahjong with various rules, from standard play to special matches featuring unique superpowers!

How to Start the "Mahjong" Mini-Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9fd902533b04902d85138f09ee6e851323c004f7.png
You can play "Mahjong" by placing the furniture "Automatic Mahjong Table" in Your Land and setting it to Public.

*Please note that the mini-game can't be played on the "Mahjong Table".

Basic Way to Play
Mahjong is a mini-game for up to 4(*a) players.
Each player begins with 13 tiles and draws (Tsumo) from the wall or claims (calls) tiles from other players (Pon, Chi, or Kan) in turn to complete a 14-tile hand with a Yaku and win.

(*a) Up to 3 CPU players can be added.

Game Flow
The player draws (tsumo) a tile from the wall and discards one they don't need on their turn.
This process is repeated to complete a winning hand with a yaku.

Rounds
The game consists of several "rounds".
The dealer seat rotates and points are calculated after each round.
In each round, the dealer gets to draw first and benefits from a scoring system that favors them over the other players (non-dealers).
If the dealer wins or the round ends in a draw (with no winner), the same player stays as "dealer".
If a "non-dealer" player wins, the next player (counterclockwise) will be the new "dealer".

Normally, a game consists of 2 rounds, the East round and the South round, known as the East-South round.
Each player gets a turn to be the dealer in each round.
(If there are no dealer repeats (Renchan), the East round consists of East 1 to East 4, and the South round consists of South 1 to South 4.)

The game ends once the predetermined number of rounds has been played.
The player with the most points at the end of the game is the winner.


Tiles
A Mahjong set consists of the following numbered tiles and honor tiles, for a total of 136 tiles.

[table][tr][th]Numbered Tiles[/th][td]"Character", "Bamboo", and "Circle", each numbered from 1 to 9.
There are four identical copies of each tile.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Honor Tiles[/th][td]The "dragon tiles" (White, Green, and Red) and the "wind tiles" (East, West, South, and North).
There are four identical copies of each of these as well.[/td][/tr][/table]

Yaku
To win, you need to complete the basic pattern of 14 tiles consisting of four melds (mentsu) and one pair (jantou), and also fulfill a specific combination or condition called a "yaku."
Each yaku has a value called "han", and the higher it is, the more points you will get when you win.

[table][tr][th]Meld (mentsu)[/th][td]A set of 3 identical tiles (triplet), or 3 consecutive numbered tiles of the same suit (sequence).[/td][/tr][tr][th]Pair (jantou)[/th][td]2 identical tiles in the "4 melds and 1 pair" pattern. [/td][/tr][/table]

How to Win
[table][tr][th]Tsumo[/th][td]Form a winning hand by drawing a tile on your own. [/td][/tr][tr][th]Ron[/th][td]Form a winning hand by claiming a tile discarded by another player.[/td][/tr][/table]

Types of Calls
A call is made when a player chooses to use a tile discarded by another player to form a meld.

[table][tr][th]Pon[/th][td]Claim a tile discarded by another player when you already have a pair of the same tile to form a triplet.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Chi[/th][td]Claim a tile discarded by the player to your left to form a sequence.  [/td][/tr][tr][th]Kan[/th][td]A set of 4 identical tiles.
Can be formed by claiming a tile discarded by another player (exposed Kan) or self-draw (concealed Kan).[/td][/tr][/table]

Dealer, Non-Dealer, and Rounds
There is one dealer and three non-dealers in each round.
Starting from the dealer and going counterclockwise, the players are referred to as East, South, West, and North.
A full rotation where each player takes a turn as the dealer is called a "round", starting with the "East round" and followed by the "South round".

Screen Display
Start Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/174e3605e27f98406d5527fd1ead39306a064fba.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Create a new room.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Join an existing room by entering the room ID (6-digit number).[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Make various adjustments to the settings.

■Tile Discard Method
Choose your discard method: "Double Tap" or "Tap".

■Voice
Adjust the volume and set the type of voice played during a match.

■Camera
Drag the center of the screen to change the camera angle.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Listen to samples of unlocked voices. Certain voices will become available for listening upon fulfilling specific conditions.[/td][/tr][tr][th]5[/th][td]Exit mini-game and return to Your Land.[/td][/tr][/table]

Room Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8676e353fd24b39f5059db4d9ae542f782f36bea.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]ID of the room created.
Other players will be able to join an existing room by entering the Room ID from "Join Room".[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Room Settings
Make changes to the settings.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Use Auto-Matching
Set Auto-Matching to ON or OFF.

■Auto-Matching
Match players who select "Use Auto-Matching" based on preset room settings.
*Auto-matching is not available when there is a CPU in the room.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Enable or disable CPU participation.[/td][/tr][tr][th]5[/th][td]Set the superpower to use.
*Only displayed if the "Superpower" rule is selected.[/td][/tr][tr][th]6[/th][td]■If the player is the room creator
Start the game once all players in the room have selected "Ready".

■If the player is not the room creator
Select "Ready" and wait for the game to start.

■When Auto-Matching is being selected
Start Auto-Matching.[/td][/tr][tr][th]7[/th][td]Return to the Start Screen[/td][/tr][/table]

Changing Room Settings
You can set the rules and various conditions that apply in the room.
[table][tr][th]Mode[/th][td]Set the number of players: "4 Players" or "3 Players".[/td][/tr][tr][th]No. of Rounds[/th][td]Set the length of the game: East-South (8 rounds)/ East only (4 rounds)/ Single Round (1 round)[/td][/tr][tr][th]Thinking Time[/th][td]Set the time allowed per turn: 5, 10, 20, or 60 seconds.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Rules[/th][td]Set the rules for the match.

■Normal
Play using standard Mahjong rules.

■Wareme (Break in the Wall)
Select one player randomly as the Wareme at the start of each round which doubles their payout.

■Superpower
Set a superpower for each player.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Dealer[/th][td]Select a player as the dealer when the game starts.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Renchan[/th][td]Enable or disable Renchan.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Overtime[/th][td]Choose to have Overtime or not.[/td][/tr][/table]

In-Match Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/62f2ae4c62562416730e5fed6e713a349d095a59.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Dora Indicator
The next tile in sequence from the indicator is the Dora tile.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]The 1,000-point stick(s) in the pot currently.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]The honba count currently.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Sort your tiles automatically. Select to enable or disable.[/td][/tr][tr][th]6[/th][td]Show or hide call options (Pon / Chi / Kan).[/td][/tr][tr][th]7[/th][td]Discard the tile you've just drawn automatically. Select to enable or disable.[/td][/tr][tr][th]8[/th][td]Options will be shown when you can declare Riichi, win by "Tsumo (Self-Draw)" or "Ron", call "Pon", "Chi" or "Kan", or use a certain superpower.
You can skip the selection when the "Skip" option is shown.[/td][/tr][tr][th]9[/th][td]Your tiles.[/td][/tr][tr][th]10[/th][td]Your turn time limit.[/td][/tr][tr][th]11[/th][td]Select to leave the match.[/td][/tr][tr][th]12[/th][td]Set discard method and camera behavior. [/td][/tr][tr][th]13[/th][td]Select to show or hide chats.[/td][/tr][tr][th]14[/th][td]Change the camera view (3D/Overhead View).[/td][/tr][tr][th]15[/th][td]Select to use a superpower.[/td][/tr][/table]

Rules
Common Rules
・Kuitan : Allowed
・Atozuke (Late Yaku Hand): Allowed
・Tobi (Bankrupt or Bust): Yes (below 0 points)
・Proceed to South (for East only)/ Proceed to West (for East-South): The game continues if the player in first place has fewer points than the required minimum at the end of the last round.
└The game ends once the player in first place reaches or exceeds the required points.
　When there are multiple winners, the dealer’s Renchan (consecutive win) takes priority.
・Red Dora included. One red 5 of each suit 
・Counted Yakuman allowed.
・Multiple Yakuman allowed.
・Double Yakuman allowed: Four Concealed Triplets - Single Wait/ Pure Nine Gates/ Thirteen Orphans - Thirteen Wait/ Four Big Winds
・Do not proceed to West (for East only)/ Do not proceed to North (for East-South)
・Dealer Changes if not in Tenpai (Ready Hand), Tenpai Renchan (the dealer stays if the dealer is in Tenpai)
・The total Noten penalty amounts to 3000 points.
・No auto-win if the last dealer is in first place and has the required points.
・In case of a tie, the player closest to the initial dealer ranks higher.
・Minimum 1-Han required to win.
・No Nagashi Mangan (Pool of Dreams)
・Pao (liability payment) for Big Three Dragons or Four Big Winds only.
└Tsumo (Draw): Full amount
　Ron: Split + any Honba
・Calling Ron to rob a concealed Kan for Thirteen Orphans is allowed.
・Kandora (additional dora revealed after Kan)/ Kanura (extra hidden dora after Kan) used.
└Flip immediately for concealed Kan, flip later for exposed Kan or late Kan.
・Yakuless (No Yaku) Tenpai allowed. 
・Furiten Riichi/ Karaten Riichi allowed.
・Can declare Riichi if you have 1000 or more points and will draw next.
・Missing a winning tile after Riichi causes the player to enter Furiten.
・A concealed Kan after Riichi is allowed as long as the tile the player is waiting on to win does not change.
・The player who misses a winning tile will enter temporary Furiten and cannot Ron until their next draw.
・Kuikae (call-and-switch from same fork) not allowed.
・In the event of multiple valid scoring options, the highest scoring option is prioritized.
・Ron > Pon/Kan > Chi
└It doesn't matter how fast the selection is made (the button is pressed) by the player. 

4-Player Mahjong
■Basic Rules
・Initial Points: 25000
・Points Required to Win 1st Place: 30000

■Rule Details
・Abortive Draw used: (Nine Terminal Draw/ Four Riichi Draw/ Four Kan Draw/ Four Wind Draw) all Renchan
・Double Ron, Triple Ron allowed.
└When multiple players win at the same time, the player closest to the dealer (clockwise) receives the point sticks/deposit.
　If the dealer wins, the dealer stays(Renchan). 

3-Player Mahjong
■Basic Rules
・Initial Points：35000
・Points Required to Win 1st Place: 40000
・Extracted Dora: Yes
・Reduced Tsumo (Self-Draw) Payout: Yes

■Rule Details
・8 Rinshan (replacement) tiles
・Tiles 2 through 8 from the character suit (Man) not used
・If the Dora indicator is "1-Man", then the Dora is "9-Man"
└If the Dora indicator is "9-Man", then the Dora is "1-Man"
・Chi is not allowed
・North is an Extracted Dora
・Dead Wall Draw with Extracted Dora (North) is allowed
・With North removed, Ippatsu, Double Riichi, and Nine Terminal Draw do not apply.
・Robbing a Kan when North is extracted is allowed (but it doesn't count as a yaku)
・Extracted North tiles are not considered discards and do not result in Furiten.
・When used in a meld, North is considered a useless wind (Otakaze).
・Abortive Draw for Nine Terminal Draw/ Four Kan Draw only. All Renchan
・Double Ron allowed
└When multiple players win at the same time, the player closest to the dealer (clockwise) receives the point sticks/deposit.
　If the dealer wins, the dealer stays(Renchan). 

List of Superpowers
[table][tr][th]Foresight[/th][td]Reveals the next tile drawn.

If another player makes a call, it will not be revealed until your next turn.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Crybaby[/th][td]Allows you to declare Riichi even after calling.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Forced Dead Wall Draw[/th][td]If you are in tenpai, the drawn tile is guaranteed to complete your hand.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Forced Last Draw Win[/th][td]If you are in tenpai, the drawn tile is guaranteed to complete your hand.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Danger Detector[/th][td]You will know whether another player is in tenpai.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Harvest Dance
*Except for Random Every Round[/th][td]The first tile discarded in the previous round becomes a dora tile only for you in the next round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Bad Habit[/th][td]When you call your 4th meld and discard a tile on a hell wait, the next tile drawn is guaranteed to complete your hand.

*Not applicable to Kakan (late kan).[/td][/tr][tr][th]Double Push[/th][td]Doubles the payout.

*Not applicable to Noten penalties.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Destiny Draw[/th][td]If you are not in tenpai, you can specify your next draw once per round.

If the tile is not available from the live wall,rinshan (replacement) tile, dead wall, then a different tile will be drawn.[/td][/tr][tr][th]East Round Specialist[/th][td]Boosts your points when you win in the East round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]South Round Specialist[/th][td]Boosts your points when you win in the South round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Renchan Specialist[/th][td]Boosts your points based on the number of dealer repeats (renchan) when you win.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Player Wind Collector[/th][td]The chance that the drawn tile is your seat wind increases.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Dora Collector[/th][td]The chance that the drawn tile is a valid dora tile increases.
Not applicable to Hidden Dora.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Low Tile Collector[/th][td]The chance that the drawn tile is a numbered tile (1 to 3) increases.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Mid Tile Collector[/th][td]The chance that the drawn tile is a numbered tile (4 to 6) increases.[/td][/tr][tr][th]High Tile Collector[/th][td]The chance that the drawn tile is a numbered tile (7 to 9) increases.[/td][/tr][tr][th]No Bust
*Except for Random Every Round[/th][td]Protects your points from falling below zero.[/td][/tr][tr][th]White Magic[/th][td]You can change the drawn tile to White once per round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Destruction[/th][td]If 4 White tiles are in your hand,White Magic can be activated 14 times.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Alpha Killer[/th][td]Grants bonus points equal to the rank difference when winning by Ron against a player who ranks higher than you.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Last Hope
*Except for Random Every Round[/th][td]Grants bonus points when winning while in last place in the last round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Imaginary Kan[/th][td]You can flip a dora when you discard a tile once per round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Kleptomania[/th][td]You can swap a tile in your hand with a discarded tile once per round.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Graffiti[/th][td]Allows you to change a White tile in your hand to a different tile.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Random[/th][td]A random ability will be selected when the game begins.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Random Every Round[/th][td]A random ability will be selected each round.[/td][/tr][/table]

Notes

*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future under different conditions after they have ended.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c0ecce0d5458dad84d50d08541e2dec44372ad5e.png
Thank you for playing Toram.

We are celebrating Toram Online's 10th Anniversary on 7/17/2025.
In order to thank you for your continued patronage, many celebration events will be held!

Toram Online will continue to evolve and bring you many more exciting contents even after the 10th Anniversary Event, so stay tuned as there's much more to come!

10th Anniversary Event Period
From: 07/10/2025 after the maintenance
Until: 08/28/2025 before the maintenance

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

10th Anniversary Arenas!
Win the Battle Against Bosses!!
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/10925e31c678680fd0c53d2cd04bc2f0ee7d4c1d.png[/td]

During the event period, 10 types of Anniversary Arena appear as event maps and you can challenge many boss monsters!
The battles are totally different from the normal boss battles!

The boss battles from the 1st-9th Anniversary Event that can be challenged at the 1st-9th venue are also brought back!

What to Expect from the Upcoming EX Arena?!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7c012b23d4a0665ff3f63f6466a6c71273013c68.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d2ade9277ac30d9bd99ae499c6ffc3b31ee006c.png[/td][/tr][/table]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/df4de3f25859665de7a0ff5dcaa1ffee3f3be3dc.png

Open the box and get random items!

*Even after the period above, the items will not be deleted, and you can open them.

From: 07/17/2025 at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)

Packed with Gorgeous Items!

Play the game every day and complete all!

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: June 27th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: June 30th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Skill Adjustments.
Enchanted Barrier

Asura Aura
Reduced the damage reduction based on remaining MP from max 50% to max 75% while Asura Aura is active.

Draconic Charge
The charge attack can now reach up to 16m depending on the charge amount

[hr][/hr] 

Proficiency Level Cap System Change
The Smith Skill "Novice's Anvil" has been renamed to "Private Anvil".
Now the proficiency limit is determined based on the current LvCap.
Once this skill reaches Lv10, Proficiency will go up to the LvCap.

As for other Anvil skills, the effect has been replaced with an effect that reduces Material Points required by the EX Skill "Customize Equipment".
Last but not least, the proficiency limit of Alchemy Skills will be determined based on the current LvCap if all Bottle skills reach Lv10.

The following issues have been fixed.

 Skills derived from Gust sometimes do not apply proration correctly.

notes.title: It's June and It's Time for the June Bride Event!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e3df4f12881cf1c09b12d4f192363e944d62a52d.png
The "June Bride" event allows you to join forces and trade with your close friends or guild members, thus improving interaction and helping you to build and develop your character.

June Bride Event Period
From: 06/12/2025 after the maintenance
Until: 07/04/2025 at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)

What's June Bride Event?
Players will be granted the event bonus below if there are 2 or more characters in the party regardless of gender.

Form a party to earn more EXP!
"EXP Gain +20%" bonus buff.

*The bonus from this campaign is not applicable to pets.
*The boost effect from this event will be stacked with the effect from Orb items and 30-Day Tickets.

Get Limited Treasure Box!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/4082d62c5e8e63b79f00672cea7bbac995ab7b8c.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a8fb86b29fc0eebf70e2b3dae580a3cfe765b14e.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Furthermore, depending on the gender of the player's character, the player can get June Bride Event-limited Treasure Box when the boss is defeated.

A male/neutral A character will get the "Groom Box" and a female/neutral B character will get the "Bride Box".
The contents of the treasure boxes for male characters and those for female characters are different and various items can be obtained randomly.

Of all the items you can get, the "June Bride Limited Equipment" has the perfect design that is suitable for the groom and the bride for their wedding.

Let's Trade "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet"!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/34b38df6abfc2c9cb87d0b2fa08726a708f41440.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0b9cbefad51f35cd91bae26e04d82e6337b23863.png[/td][/tr][/table]
If you trade "Marriage Gift (Empty)" or "Toss Bouquet" with another adventurer or receive it as a gift during the June Bride Event, the item will become untradable and the "Selling Price" as well as the "Material Points" will greatly increase.

Why don't you take this opportunity and try trading them with your friends or guild members?

Let's redecorate Your Land!
Example of Craftable Furniture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6b9386f1d7d2c2efc8ae44a51f2fb7f10f7bfd3f.png
Items for Your Land that can be created with materials obtained from June Bride Event are available!

Why don't you take this chance to change your Land's design?
 
Notes
*Mercenaries, partners and pets are not counted as party members.
*Please note that "Groom Box" and "Bride Box" cannot be obtained from certain boss monsters.
*A male/neutral A character can get the "Groom Box" and a female/neutral B character can get the "Bride Box".
*The "Groom Box" and the "Bride Box" will be removed through the maintenance held on 07/10/2025.
*The increased "Selling Price" and "Material Points" as well as the creator name of "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will be attached only if they are traded with another player or sent as a gift.
"Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will remain the same even if they are sold on the Consignment Board.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ed0c1da48f4a1b1b585bdb529b1ea8a36f09639e.png
We are holding a collaboration event with "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" after the maintenance on May 29, 2025.

This collab event features avatars that can transform you into the characters that appear in "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" as well as an exclusive event boss battle against "Machine God Maple"!

Enjoy the exciting limited-time collab content!

Event Period
From: 5/29/2025 after maintenance
Until: 6/26/2025 before maintenance

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

"Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" Collab Avatar Chest Available!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e717084d31f8e972378c1d55bca626b16d15a6f2.png
Collab-Exclusive Avatar Chests to get avatars that let you transform into characters from "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" are available!
If you own these collab avatars, you will get a bonus on the Maple Points earned from the collab event battle.

Don't miss out on the special avatars that you can only get through this opportunity!

Available for Purchase
From: 5/29/2025 after maintenance
Until: 6/26/2025 before maintenance

"Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" Exclusive Collaboration Battle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/aff21c350df56f1d4e8944a28f81290f3456bae3.png
An event battle against "Machine God Maple" is available during the event!
It's a battle where you must deal as much damage as possible within the time limit.

Make sure to challenge the limited boss battle to get exclusive collab items and other gorgeous rewards at the Prize Exchange!

*Deal a certain amount of damage to "Machine God Maple" to trigger an item‐drop chance.

[EDIT]
・The option to turn matching ON/OFF is now available.
When it is turned OFF, the Weekly Challenge will become unavailable and you won't be able to complete it.

・The Party Alliance feature is now available for event battles.
Matching is always turned OFF when using Party Alliance.

How to Participate
Move to the special event map through the NPC "Bofuri 2 Collab Venue" in "Sofya City".

Let's Earn "Maple Points" to Get Collab-Exclusive Items!
The "Maple Points" you have earned can be exchanged for collab-exclusive emotions and useful items for your adventure at the Prize Exchange while it is available.
The more damage you deal within the time limit, the more "Maple Points" you'll earn! So, try to deal as much damage as possible to earn lots of "Maple Points"!

[EDIT]
・The maximum points that can be earned from your damage score has been increased from 10x to 20x.
・The total point increase from collab avatars has been adjusted from 200% to 400%.
・The point multiplier based on the Defender ratio now has a minimum limit.

Collab Prize Exchange Period
From: 5/29/2025 after maintenance
Until: 7/10/2025 before maintenance

Collab-Exclusive Emblems Available! Play Every Day to Get Items!
You can get gorgeous items that are useful for your adventure if you log in to Toram Online and fulfill the conditions during the event!
Make sure to log in every day and get various daily bonuses!

[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Bofuri Collab Emblem 1/3[/td][td]Log in to the game.[/td][td]Revive Droplet x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bofuri Collab Emblem 2/3[/td][td]Play the game for 1 hour.[/td][td]EXP Gain +50% for 1 day[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bofuri Collab Emblem 3/3[/td][td]Defeat the collab event boss.[/td][td]Orb Shard x30[/td][/tr][/table]

Exclusive Collab Daily Bonus Claim Period
From: 5/29/2025 after maintenance
Until: 6/26/2025 before maintenance

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*You can claim and receive emblems after clearing the conditions from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem].

Photo Contest in Celebration of "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" x "Toram Online" Collab!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6303f7793d0e42ab43e3f5fdd9316184578db839.png
We are holding a photo contest to celebrate the collaboration between "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" and "Toram Online"!

Please post in-game screenshots or illustrations related to the collab with "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2" on X!
The winners will receive useful in-game items!

What's "Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense Season 2"?
Maple is obsessed with the VRMMO game "NewWorld Online".

Since she maxed out her defense stats, it initially seemed like she'd be stuck with a sluggish and tanky playstyle,
but after picking up several insane skills, she went on an unstoppable spree of domination!
Because of her unusual fighting style, she became a well-known player regarded as the "last boss".

"Maple Tree", a guild she founded with her best friend, Sally, has brought together many unique and reliable companions,
strengthening their bond even further.

And then...

"NewWorld Online" added new floors!
Will Maple join forces with her former rivals and make new friends? 
Will new events be held?!
Should we expect Maple and her friends to go on another rampage here...?


As the world gets bigger, the adventure gets even more exciting!

Notes

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/80395f4719b3e8c012391dbca2468d4c18a39a33.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

We have performed several adjustments for the balances of the existing skills during the maintenance on 4/24/2025.
Along with skill balance adjustments, skill & stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 4/24/2025 after the maintenance
Until: 5/9/2025 5:00 AM(JST/GMT+9)

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 04/24/2025 before the maintenance) x 3
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 30 times in total.

How to Reset
Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fffa507dc45916c00b22335280f5a62f523936f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/beed805ee680a96d177cb4c95c2d852f523aa2fa.png[/td][/tr][/table]
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"]

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/eecfea4b5a5599b330a0b7da9e108be50057f1a3.png
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"]

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Library is Here![/td][td]NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Let's Make Use of the EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a60d20df6b4fd79816080579cc9b76b3d9feee21.png
[Menu > Character > Skills > Use EX Skills > Alchemy Skills]

The EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills will be unlocked if "Technical Synthesis I" Lv1 or higher has been acquired.

・The option to "Save Color" will only be shown when the equipment has color info.
Multiple colors can be selected and saved.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.
Please note that if the success rate is low, the equipment may not be colored although the saved color has been used.

Furthermore, the result of the transmutation will be the initial(default) equipment for each equipment type.

*The equipment which color is fetched will be lost including the crysta.
*Depending on the value of the Personal Stat "LUK", it may not generate anything when it fails.
The equipment used as material will be returned.
*The option to "Save Color" will not be shown when the equipment is locked, equipped or only has the color that has reached the maximum save limit.
*Colors will be saved per equipment.
*The maximum limit of the same color that can be saved is 99 for each "Part A/ Part B/ Part C" for each type of equipment.
*The color is saved per account.
*If the status of "Technical Synthesis I" becomes "Not Acquired Yet" due to "Skill Tree Reset", the EX Skill "Color Saving" will become unavailable. However, the colors you have saved will not be lost.
*If there is an active 30-Day Ticket, the character name will be added to the transmuted equipment.

notes.title: Skill Balance Adjustment
notes.content:
Skill balance will be adjusted during the update on Thursday, April 24, 2025.
For more details, please refer to the following descriptions.


Skill Balance Adjustment
Blade Skills
■Gladiate
Added a bonus that doubles the effect of damage reduction from Gladiate if a shield is equipped.

■Ogre Slash
Buff duration increased from max 23 seconds to max 60 seconds.


Shot Skills
■Paralysis Shot
■Smoke Dust
■Arm Break
Increased the chance of inflicting a status ailment by 20 when an arrow is equipped.
When used with a bow and arrow, the chance to inflict a status ailment is now 100% at skill level 5.

■Hunting Buddy
The normal attacks while Twin Storm is active will now also enhance the companion's attack.

■Piercing Shot
Increased the duration of invincibility gained when activated with a bowgun from 1 second to 1.5 seconds. Moving with Evasion while charging will no longer remove this invincibility.

■Spread Shot
Reduced the sensitivity of arrow direction control with the directional keys (forward or back) when using a bow.
It is now harder to hit small monsters, but large monsters can still be hit easily.
Projectile performance for normal activation remains unchanged, taking into account the risks of approaching the enemy.

After carefully considering its synergy with Retrograde Shot's additional damage, it has been adjusted so that the additional damage is limited to a maximum of 4 times per activation of Spread Shot.


Magic Skills
■Magic: Arrows
Skill power boost value has been adjusted from max 50 to max 140.
Fixed an issue where applying double shot using Spell Calibration did not decrease the total number of shots.

■Magic: Wall
Added a bonus of base INT:10 to the power multiplier.
Skill power boost value has been adjusted from max 120 to max 220.

■Magic: Storm
Skill power boost value has been adjusted from max 400 to max 420

■Enchanted Barrier
Quick activation of Maximizer inside the barrier will no longer restore the HP of the barrier.
The barrier will now take more damage when taking fatal damage.
Max HP boost effect from equipment stats, etc. will now be applied to the barrier too.

Initially, we enabled Maximizer to activate quickly to prevent excessive DPS drop, 
however, since the barrier rarely ran out of HP and players could withstand all damage, the barrier HP recovery effect has been removed, while the MP recovery effect is retained.
Additionally, since the decrease in the player's Max HP can negate almost all fractional damage, effects related to Max HP will now apply to the barrier as well.


Martial Skills
■Asura Aura
Reduced the power boost from 1.3x to 1.1x while Asura Aura is active. The original 1.3x boost still applies to certain skill trees (*Martial, Crusher, Dagger, Assassin, and Dark Power Skills).
Reduced the damage reduction based on remaining MP from max 95% to max 50% while Asura Aura is active.


Halberd Skills
■Draconic Charge
Adjusted the MATK boost formula for stage 2 fan-shaped attack.


Dual Sword Skills
■Aerial Slay
Fixed an issue where the power didn't change according to the skill level. (Lv10 power was applied all the time).

■Horizon Cut
The MP cost will now be 300, even when used as a combo opener.
It no longer has proration.


Magic Blade Skills
■Conversion
Changed the formula for the passive MATK boost effect.
With this adjustment, MATK+●% from equipment stats will now affect the boost value by  Conversion.

■Union Sword
Derived skill is no longer affected by action speed.
The "Swift" combo effect remains in effect.


Priest Skills
■Aspis Soul
The fractional damage reduction effect will now be applied even when targeted under certain conditions (*attacks that target non-tanks, such as long-range and random targeting).


Wizard Skills
■Imperial Ray
Shortened the cast time from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.
It no longer has proration.
You no longer need to collaborate with the familiar because now the additional damage will always be a critical hit.
You will now inflict [Weaken] to the target  with the element you are weak to when you deal additional damage to them. (the mechanism works differently when the element is Neutral only.)


Crusher Skills
■Goliath Punch
If "Divine Rigid Body" has been acquired and "Annihilator" is active, you will now gain 1 charge each time you deal damage with a Crusher Skill.


Partisan Skills
■Lepage's Boomerang
■Lepage's Boomerang II
■Lepage's Boomerang III
Adjusted the power multiplier from a maximum of 500% to a maximum of 450%.

Other Changes
■Status Ailment [Weaken]
If a staff or a magic device is equipped as the main weapon, the effect of "Weaken" can now be triggered regardless of elemental weaknesses.

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a60d20df6b4fd79816080579cc9b76b3d9feee21.png
[Menu > Character > Skills > Use EX Skills > Alchemy Skills]

The EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills will be unlocked if "Technical Synthesis I" Lv1 or higher has been acquired.

・The option to "Save Color" will only be shown when the equipment has color info.
Multiple colors can be selected and saved.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.

・The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.

Only equipment with saved colors can be selected.
When fetching color, the number of color selections and success rate depend on your equipment synthesis ability.
Please note that if the success rate is low, the equipment may not be colored although the saved color has been used.

Furthermore, the result of the transmutation will be the initial(default) equipment for each equipment type.

*The equipment which color is fetched will be lost including the crysta.
*Depending on the value of the Personal Stat "LUK", it may not generate anything when it fails.
The equipment used as material will be returned.
*The option to "Save Color" will not be shown when the equipment is locked, equipped or only has the color that has reached the maximum save limit.
*Colors will be saved per equipment.
*The maximum limit of the same color that can be saved is 99 for each "Part A/ Part B/ Part C" for each type of equipment.
*The color is saved per account.
*If the status of "Technical Synthesis I" becomes "Not Acquired Yet" due to "Skill Tree Reset", the EX Skill "Color Saving" will become unavailable. However, the colors you have saved will not be lost.
*If there is an active 30-Day Ticket, the character name will be added to the transmuted equipment.

3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: March 28th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: March 31st at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]

Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.

A new quest for White Day Event, "The Alluring Sweets Desired by All", has been added.
Furthermore, the White Day limited quests from previous years are also being brought back!

Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Cookie" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Blue Wrapping Ribbon"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d097cb7377e06065637892d19ff4cdb9e329602.png
During the event period, you can create "Heart Cookie" by collecting the "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Cookie" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Cookie" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Cookie"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6d8dc6ce99eaf53172e7f056738deed055ad166a.png
If you trade "Heart Cookie" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its MP healing effect will increase by 10 times.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for White Day.

How about giving them to your friends or guild members who always help you out?

Notes
*You cannot obtain "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" from special event maps such as Guild Maze or Challenge Dungeon.
*The creator's name of the "Heart Cookie" will be displayed only when it is traded during the event period.
"Heart Cookie"'s MP healing effect increases only when it is traded during the event period.
The aforementioned changes will not apply to the "Heart Cookie" when sent via gift or sold with the Consignment system.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b28900cba43ba6796f9ccda50782ba02d329471b.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c671faad3ed3277828b0dd35dd341d29f09667d0.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Let's redecorate Your Land!
