notes.title: Limited Event: "Snowball Fight" Released! Hit Snowballs!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/afa309bbc2685ba6a076219765310c3b38f441d3.png
Now you can play "Snowball Fight" in the world of Toram Online for a limited period of time after the maintenance 3/6/2025!
 Use and exchange the "Snowball Points" you get from "Snowball Fight" for rare items that are exclusive to this event!

Make sure to play it with your jolly good friends or guild members and enjoy the exciting game!

"Snowball Fight" Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 3/6/2025
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/10/2025

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

What is Snowball Fight?
Players are divided into 2 teams and compete the number of snowballs they hit within 3 minutes.

Tips for Snowball Fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2580c687ea2dbafe97c231bc1b345d94c0b085ec.png
You can access the mini-game venue from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Go to snowball fight venue" at Save Point.

Also, you can go to Save Point from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Back to Town" from the mini-game venue.

Overview
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Tap "I'm ready!!" after moving to the snowball fight field.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]The game will start with selected players via auto-matching.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]The winner is the team that holds more HP than the other.
Snowball Points will increase a little and you will get 1 Ice & Snow Bucket if you win.
[/td][/tr][/table]
*You cannot get the item if your bag is full.
*"Snow Bear Box" that you can get from Prize Exchange has a low chance to appear too from "Ice & Snow Bucket".

Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/76f45b1a60e3e3ec8f76b67b7c2722579431dba1.png
[table][tr][th]HP[/th][td]It decreases if you are hit by opponents.
Blue HP shows allied team's HP, red shows opponent team's HP.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Make[/th][td]You can sit down and create snowballs.
The more you hold snowballs, the longer it takes to create a snowball.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Throw[/th][td]You can throw a snowball.
Snowballs are thrown toward the "+" mark in front of the screen.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Auto[/th][td]You can throw a snowball to a player within the range and sight.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Dodge[/th][td]You can dodge snowballs by quickly moving a short distance.
If you are holding snowballs, you may lose them.[/td][/tr][/table]
* All throwing motions will become slower if you are in the enemy's zone.

Tips
Identify teams by the color indicated beneath each player.
HP is shared by all players in the same team.

About Frostbite and Respawn
If you get hit by a snowball, you will flinch and get frostbite that causes the screen to freeze for a little bit. If you get another hit in this condition, you will tumble and the screen will continue to freeze. Furthermore, if you get a third hit, you will freeze to death. After the death animation is shown, you will be taken back to the starting point and you lose 200 HP.

You will heal or return to the previous stage of frostbite if you don't get hit for 12 seconds. 
You will be invincible for a few seconds when you flinch or tumble.

Snowball Fight gets more exciting with items!!
Treasure Boxes Appear on the Snowball Fight Field!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0aede5225772860167647fda563a89fb45852975.png
You can get a "30-second Buff Item" by tapping the treasure box that appears on the Snowball Fight field!

[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Buff[/th][/tr][tr][td]Ice Meteor[/td][td]Ice chunks fall if you place a snowball on the ground![/td][/tr][tr][td]Ice Barrier[/td][td]No frostbite for up to 3 hits![/td][/tr][tr][td]Team Rescue[/td][td]Fully recover from frostbite.Team HP restored![/td][/tr][tr][td]Jumbo Ball[/td][td]Snowballs become bigger![/td][/tr][tr][td]Triple[/td][td]Snowballs thrown become 3![/td][/tr][/table]
Also, you can steal the buff from knocking down a buffed player!

Have fun using the items and use of them well to lead your team to victory!!

Snowball Fight Limited Special Daily Emblems Available!
Emblems that give you Ticket Pieces and other items will be available during the event period below.

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems
[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (Participate)[/td][td]Play Snowball Fight 2 times
Join from Terminal[/td][td]Revive Droplet x2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (1st Victory)[/td][td]Win Snowball Fight once.[/td][td]Ticket Piece x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Ticket Bonus[/td][td]Obtain a 30-Day Ticket.[/td][td]Ice & Snow Bucket x2[/td][/tr][/table]
Win the snowball fight and get gorgeous items every day!

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems Available Period
From: After the maintenance on 3/6/2025
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/10/2025

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*Emblems can be received when the conditions are met from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem. ].

Notes
*The battle begins after all the party members tap "I'm ready!!".
*The snowballs made during the previous match cannot be used.
*If matchmaking fails within the time limit after tapping "I'm ready!!", you will return to waiting mode to tap "I'm ready!!" again.
*Ranking based on the number of snowball you threw does not affect your win or loss.
*You will not be able to tap a new treasure box to get an additional buff when you still have a buff that is active.
*If you knock down a buffed player from the opponent's team while having an active buff, the buff stolen from the player will be granted to one of your team members.
However, if all players in your team already have a buff that is active, the stolen buff will disappear.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: New Skills Added to 5 Skill Trees!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8866a4e467a9bd9ad933826179f613ee885b1507.png
We have added new skills to the skill trees below during the maintenance on Thursday, February 27, 2025.
-Shot Skills
-Magic Skills
-Martial Skills
-Dual Sword Skills
-Halberd Skills

Take this opportunity to learn new skills!

How to Acquire the Skills
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"　　　　[/td][/tr][/table]
You can acquire the skill tree from the NPC "Lilulu" in the library in "Sofya City" with Spinas when your level meets the requirement.
The skill tree can also be acquired by using the item specified respectively.

Level Requirement Shot Skills/Magic Skills/Martial Skills/Halberd Skills
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]Lv10 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv30 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv70 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv4[/td][td]Lv150 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv5[/td][td]Lv240 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Level Requirement Dual Sword Skills
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]Lv30 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv50 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv90 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv4[/td][td]Lv170 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv5[/td][td]Lv250 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Shot Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv4
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hunting Buddy[/td][td]Summons your companion to fight alongside you.
It attacks every few seconds, causing normal attack proration. The effect that enhances your companion's next attack will stack when you hit the target with a Shot Skill.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Piercing Shot[/td][td]An arrow that pierces even the strongest defense.
Aims and attacks in a straight line with a Charge Skill (5 Levels). You can move and adjust the direction with Evasion. Each hit increases its performance and slightly restores MP.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spread Shot[/td][td]Attacks using 5 skillfully controlled arrows.
Chance to inflict a status ailment(weapon element) on the target.
 Each hit on the same target slightly improves its performance.
You can also change the direction the arrows are fired by using the directional keys.[/td][/tr][/table]

Magic Skills
Below are the skills added.
Lv4
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Spell Calibration[/td][td]The ability to adjust magic to suit your needs.
Allows you to adjust certain Magic Skills up to Skill Tree Lv3.

*It doesn't affect Enchanted Spell.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Magic: Laser[/td][td]A technique to simplify magic and release its power with the caster's ability. Power increases based on the remaining MP when activated.
Low chance to inflict a status ailment(weapon element).
 After activation,your Magic Pierce slightly increases.[/td][/tr][/table]

Martial Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv5
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Mountain Press[/td][td]A powerful shoulder strike.
Chance to inflict [Stun] on the target.

*If the stun debuff is prevented due to active resistance, the buff effect from the skill "Aggravate" will be applied.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Seismic Stomp[/td][td]Throws your opponent off balance with a heavy stomp.
 Chance to inflict [Flinch] on the target.
If successful, a large amount of MP will be restored.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spin Sweep/Wheel Kick[/td][td]Trips your opponent with a leg sweep.
Chance to inflict [Tumble] on the target.

If successful, you will perform additional attacks and gain a buff for a few seconds.[/td][/tr][/table]

Dual Sword Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv4
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aerial Slay[/td][td]Slashes your enemy while trifling with them.
When activated with a combo (except as opener),the required MP becomes 100.

You can move with the directional keys while the skill is active.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Horizon Cut[/td][td]Surprises your enemy with a swift backhand slash.
The MP Cost for the next skill used is halved.
The required MP becomes 300 when used as a combo finisher.
You will tumble if you take damage while it is active.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sting Blade[/td][td]Closes the distance with a very sharp thrust.
As long as it is not a Graze, hitting the target will boost your piercing power.
The power increases further based on the piercing power that exceeds the maximum value.[/td][/tr][/table]

Halberd Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv3
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Blitz Spike[/td][td]A swift spear thrust wrapped in lightning.
Chance to inflict [Paralysis] when activated near the target. If paralyzed, the target will take additional magic damage.
 When activated at adistance, lightning spears that automatically attack approaching enemies will be summoned.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv4
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lightning Hail[/td][td]A spear technique that summons multiple lightning strikes from the sky.
 Generates multiple attacks that deal magic damage around the target.
More likely to hit paralyzed targets.

Grants invincibility to yourself when activated.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table equalcells=1][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Thor's Hammer[/td][td]A spear technique that calls down a massive lightning strike.
 A magic attack with guaranteed critical, but the damage will be split among targets caught in the blast.
 Once activated, your Additional Magic, Magic Pierce, and Accuracy Rate will increase for a certain period of time.[/td][/tr][/table]

3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: February 21st at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: February 25th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]

    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

During the collab, a limited event battle to defend the "Concert Stage" from the approaching monsters will be held!

How to Play "HATSUNE MIKU" Collaboration Limited Event Battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e456868dc5b5c9b4d103fe52f067026ec712e21f.png
During the event period, you can move to the collaboration limited event map from the "Potum" in "Sofya City".

What Kind of Thing Happens during the Collaboration Limited Event?

Once the challenge starts, monsters will come to attack one after another.
The monsters will target and invade the "Concert Stage", so your job is to repel them and not let them damage the "Concert Stage"!

You will fail the challenge if the durability of the "Concert Stage" becomes 0.

When there is little time left, the boss monster will appear.
"The boss monster's attack will greatly reduce the durability of the "Concert Stage".
So, cooperate with your party members and defeat the boss monster!"

Exchange Your "MAGICAL Points"! Lots of Gorgeous Items Available!

You can exchange the "MAGICAL Points" obtained through the collaboration limited event battle for items by talking to the NPC "Concert Potum".

The exchange for each item will take place by using the required number of "MAGICAL Points".
You can exchange the points for event-limited equipment and many other gorgeous items!

Let's get gorgeous items by actively participating in the collaboration limited event battle!

What is “Hatsune Miku”?
Hatsune Miku is music software developed by Crypton Future Media, INC., and it enables anyone to make the computer sing by entering lyrics and melodies.

As a massive number of users created music using the software and posted their works on the Internet, Hatsune Miku quickly evolved into a cultural phenomenon.

Moreover, Hatsune Miku has gained much attention as a character, involved in many fields such as merchandising and live performance as a virtual singer. Now her popularity has spread across the globe.

※Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO and KAITO are also virtual singers developed by Crypton Future Media, INC.

What is "MAGICAL MIRAI"?
Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai" is combined event of 3DCG live concert of virtual singers such as Hatsune Miku, and an exhibition where you will be able to experience the creative culture surrounding Hatsune Miku.

Enjoy creating; seeing artworks; supporting creators; meeting friends who like the same character, artwork, creator; and learning about new technologies or collaborations, etc. By making Hatsune Miku and her friends a creative hub, we are hoping to make space for people to gather and have fun tied together with the keyword “creativity”.

Hatsune Miku will be joined by Kagamine Rin & Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO at the event.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: January 24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: January 27th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2ae8e16d1af8c7842a23806495ab694544482740.png
"Megiston", who might be the most energetic guy in Toram Online, is back once again!
Can you complete "Road of Megiston" where mighty bosses await you?

He's waiting for your challenge at the arena!

Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 12/26/2024
Until: Before the maintenance on 1/23/2025

What's Road of Megiston?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ccc07ef7bec5107e3a185f830ffb40709bc0fc54.png
"Road of Megiston" is an event held in a special map to defeat several boss monsters in a knockout tournament. 
You can challenge it as many times as you want during the event period as long as you meet the requirements and are able to pay the participation fee.

You can get gorgeous rewards everytime you win a battle, so try your best to win all the battles!

Also, you can play the year-end/new-year event "Road of Megiston".

You can receive EXP and the following rewards each time you win the battle.

What is a Megiston Box?
Megiston Box is a consumable item reward for Road of Megiston and there are 3 types of grade: Gold, Silver, and Bronze.
It contains various items, and you have a chance to get powerful Crystas from Silver and Gold boxes.
Please note that the items that can be obtained from each Megiston Box vary.

As you move ahead to the next battle, the chance to get higher grade boxes increases!
Try your best to win all the battles to get greater rewards!

notes.content:

[EDIT:12/25 17:30 PM(JST)]
We have decided to extend the event until the maintenance on Thursday, Jan 9, 2025 (JST).

Please note that no gifts will be delivered to your Xmas Stockings from Wednesday, Jan 1, 2025 onward.

[EDIT:12/19 3:00 PM(JST)]
A new difficulty level, "Very Hard", has been added to the boss monster of the popular ongoing Xmas Event quest "Sacred Dark Lineage".

"Sacred Dark Lineage", a new scenario released for the first time in 2024, has become available after the maintenance on 12/12/2024.
 
After you have completed the Xmas Event quest "Sacred Power Reversal Mayhem", go talk to "Pelulu" in "Navida City" and select "Sacred Dark Lineage" to start the quest.
 
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/fa59ffdd01257a4923c085c44dae5d1605fc3306.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/32bd9afeae3433c876d28c9bb3835ae827e6416c.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Pelulu and the adventurer have come to Navida City too this year.
They see Velly and Dunder who look very busy preparing for Xmas.

It seems that they have run out of the "Magic Black Coal" that powers the dolls, so Shawle is helping them too.

Velly also asks Pelulu and the adventurer to gather some "Magic Black Coal", so they head to the Aldozat Forest.

Meanwhile, Shawle comes across tree roots emitting a strange light. When he touches them, a mysterious voice echoes in his head...

Please spend your Xmas this year with Toram Online!

Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 11/28/2024
[strike]Until: 11:59 PM (JST/GMT+9) on 12/31/2024[/strike]
Until: Before the maintenance on 1/9/2025

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9ebb0c60bdd46e3b979294d0a01226b2fc00d696.png
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Notes
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/80395f4719b3e8c012391dbca2468d4c18a39a33.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 12/12/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 12/26/2024 before the maintenance

The Number of Resets Available
You can reset skills and stats up to 3 times in total.

How to Reset
Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fffa507dc45916c00b22335280f5a62f523936f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/beed805ee680a96d177cb4c95c2d852f523aa2fa.png[/td][/tr][/table]
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"]

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/eecfea4b5a5599b330a0b7da9e108be50057f1a3.png
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"]

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Library is Here![/td][td]NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [EDIT]Merry Early Christmas! Xmas Event Is Back ON!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6b95fde7426291d5af17af9a2e40e540b2e3fe01.png
[EDIT:12/25 17:30 PM(JST)]
We have decided to extend the event until the maintenance on Thursday, Jan 9, 2025 (JST).
The wormhole for the Xmas Event from Wednesday, Jan 1, 2025 onward will be accessible from "Sofya City".

Please note that no gifts will be delivered to your Xmas Stockings from Wednesday, Jan 1, 2025 onward.

The Xmas Event held up to 2023 has been reinstated through the maintenance on 11/28/2024.

Bringing you lots of fun including limited-edition quests and recipes, as well as events where gifts are delivered daily to your Xmas Stockings by Santa Claus!

Meanwhile, the new content of Xmas Event for 2023 will be added through the maintenance at a later date.

Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 11/28/2024
[strike]Until: 11:59 PM (JST/GMT+9) on 12/31/2024[/strike]
Until: Before the maintenance on 1/9/2025

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Limited map "Navida's Relics" Is Opened & Recipes Are Brought Back!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f918aa94958e5f3a33935b5b3d53ac42b82925a7.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d038554535f6c3cbbe3d7343e11131b546ad12c.png[/td][/tr][/table]
The event maps that appeared in the previous Xmas Event will reappear.

Navida's Relics can be accessed from the wormhole at "Sofya City", "El Scaro", "Hora Diomedea","Draco Town" and "Polde Ice Valley" during the event period.
Also, the wormhole to "Frozen Navida City" is at "Navida's Relics".

We hope you can enjoy the Xmas Event to the fullest at the limited-edition Xmas-themed maps!

*You can access Polde Ice Valley from Navida's Relics by completing the Xmas quests.

*"Polde Ice Valley" and "Fort Solfini" are not event-limited maps.
You can freely explore the maps event after the event ends.

*The content of "Fort Solfini" after the Xmas Event ends will be the same as that in "Difficulty: Lv70-90".

Xmas Limited Quests Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0580f12acac53033192e4169ce749dd8d7f7c6f7.png

Enjoy your adventure with them in a map full of Xmas sensation!

*Emblems can be received when the conditions are met from [ Menu > News > You've got Emblem. ].


Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/5b6e1429a031dd48384f447825ce481800869756.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c2b7bc3b6466394262e0ae26f3b2754d6329c80b.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Spend as much time as you wish with your members at the Guild Bar that is different from the usual one.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: November 22nd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: November 25th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: October 25th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: October 28th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: September 27th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: September 30th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]

    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: August 23rd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: August 26th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: July 26th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: July 29th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

A new boss monster has been added to the Summer Event exclusive map "Underwater Canyon"!
Make sure to defeat the boss monster to get new equipment!

After the maintenance, "Saltau's Beach" which is a private beach has been opened for this scorching summer.
This map will let you feel the heat of summer excitement with the special monsters inhabiting the white sand beach facing the blue sea!
And what's more, you can play a "Diving" mini-game in the sea!

Event Period

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Event Details

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a143c386868b660089f3b99c13098f950273361c.png

You can accept the Summer Event-limited quest from the NPC "Pelulu" in Saltau's Beach.

Let's Get "Summer Shell" from water element monsters!

    [/tr]

Take note of the monster's element and hunt them during the event period!

*Summer Shell III can only be obtained through Challenge Dungeon (Lv300 or more).

Gigantic Octopus Invasion!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8508db8219d6fd049a1cc4cebe33a283452f3771.png
"Gigantic Octopus Invasion", the RAID battle that can be challenged by up to 8 players at the same time is currently available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c6c618a173616aaea7bf76d0646d86876eed2a4b.png
You can challenge it from the wormhole in "Saltau's Beach"!

A second party can enter the battle after the first party enters the battle field.
The second and subsequent parties can only join within a certain period of time after the battle begins and the boss monster must have a certain amount of HP left.

Defeat the "Gigantic Octopus" to get new equipment that is perfect for this hot summer and "Big Takoyaki" which is a buff item to enhance your stats!

Enjoy the hot RAID battle with your friends and guild mates!

Notes
*The matching for RAID Battle can be enabled/disabled.
*When another party is joining the battle, the party members' HP will show up as a whole on the left side of the screen as "Secondary Party".
*The result rewards such as Attacker and Breaker will be defined in each party.
*Skills that affect party members such as the Support Skill "High Cycle" and Shield Skill "Guardian" will only affect the members in your party during the RAID Battle.
However, skills that can be used on a selected player such as the Support Skill "Heal" and "Recovery" can also be used on the player that is in another party.


Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!

Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/51cf7aabb3a8d8a6d69c947b947ce5ae21a0785d.png

Furthermore, you can tame the special monsters inhabiting the beach as pets and go on adventures with them!

They are valuable monsters that you can only find here, so make sure you take the challenge!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Notes

notes.title: Let the Fun Begin at the Summer Beach! Special Maps & Mini-Game "Diving" Appear!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7785cd47b02ec841e26084737f72c7610520ff8e.png
Limited-edition beach maps to enjoy the heat of summer excitement to the fullest and "Diving", a special mini-game that can be played at the beach, have been added through the maintenance on 7/25/2024.

Spend this summer with Toram Online too!

Mini Game "Diving" Period
From: 7/25/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 9/12/2024 before the maintenance

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Explore the Blue Ocean! Let's Dive!
You can challenge the mini-game "Diving" at Saltau's Beach.
Diving is a game to obtain "Fisherman Points" by attacking and defeating various monsters as you move around in the water.
"Gigantic Octopus Battle" and "Free-Diving" are the 2 types of game modes you can play.
The details are as follows.

Gigantic Octopus Battle
In this mode, you team up with your friends to defeat "Gigantic Octopus". You may bring various diving items with you and get many Fisherman Points.

Also, the number of Fisherman Points you get will increase as a result of the drop rate booster effect from your 30-Day Tickets, items, equipment, and etc..

*Please note that the increment will not be applied in Free-Diving mode.

Please note that 1 Stamina from the player who created the room will be used when playing the challenge.
Once the game begins, the Gigantic Octopus will automatically appear after a certain amount of time, so try your best to defeat as many monsters as possible before that to obtain a lot of Fisherman Points!

The room creator in this mode can get more Fisherman Points when the battle against the Gigantic Octopus is completed.

How to Play Gigantic Octopus Battle
You need to either create or join a room created by other players to play Gigantic Octopus Battle.
There are 2 types of rooms, those that can be joined by anyone and those that can only be joined by friends, party or guild members, and acquaintances.
The condition to join the room can also be changed after the diving game has started.

To join a room created by other players, select one from the list. (Up to 15 rooms shown per condition)
The rooms joined by your friends, guild or party members will be shown if you tap "For Acquaintances Only".

Free-Diving
You can swim freely in the ocean in this mode.
You can't bring diving items with you, so you can't get many Fisherman Points. But you can enjoy diving without using any stamina.
You will get used to the diving controls by playing in this mode.

How to Check Diving Stamina
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/09576a1ea4712eef83e56940c1ac03d4f8b02966.png
At Saltau's Beach, you can always check your Diving Stamina and Diving Items by tapping the button at the center of the screen.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/49ebb7b3d7991db2ba6f145432400f9a2c4ceed8.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3766be47777042cba6a7655eb8fffe13f76ab77b.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Also, you can get more Fisherman Points if you use Diving Items, so just buy from Saltau when you need them.

Diving items are carried over from 2021.

Diving Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7771c8df1291d072a4f0b025a37c308de8211496.png
1. Menu
You can cancel diving, see the names of the participating players, or change the condition of the room you have created.
In Free-Diving mode, the button changes to "Back".

2. AUTO LOCK
It shows the status of AUTO LOCK.
The yellow mark means it is turned ON, while the grey mark means it is turned OFF.
When it is turned ON, the targeted monsters will be attacked.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

3. Oxygen Gauge
It shows the oxygen left.
The oxygen will gradually decrease while diving. Using Dodge or getting attacked by monsters will also reduce it.
Diving ends when it becomes 0.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

4. Fishing Lv
It shows your diving progress.
The level goes up as you defeat more monsters. As the level goes up, monsters that give you more Fisherman Points will appear.
The highest level is 6.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

5. Current Fisherman Points
It shows the Fisherman Points you have obtained during the dive.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

6. Number of Players Participating in the Dive
It shows the total number of players joining the room.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

7. Monsters
The monsters you can attack in the water.
The number of Fisherman Points you can earn depends on the monsters.

8. Change Weapon
The button to switch between harpoon and bowgun.
You can buy arrows from Saltau at the beach house.
It will not be shown in Free-Diving mode.

9. Action
Attack near the lock-on cursor with the current weapon.

10. Depth Lock Icon
Tap it to stop going higher or lower from the current depth.

11. Depth
It shows the current depth.

12. Dodge
You will briefly move at high speed if you tap it while moving forward or moving to the left or right.

Notes
*"Fisherman Points" will be deleted through the maintenance after this event ends.
*Stamina is restored over time, but you can also restore it by talking to Saltau and selecting "Eat Food" or using Spinas and Orbs.
However, please note that it will cost you more Spinas each time you restore Stamina with them.
After a certain amount of time, the Spina Cost will go down to the lowest point.
*In Gigantic Octopus Battle mode, the room will automatically be dismissed if the creator decides to cancel diving.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Anybody", only players playing in the same World as the room creator can join.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Acquaintances Only", the creator, participating friends, guild or party members will be shown in the room creator column.
*When the condition to join the room is set to "Acquaintances Only", the participants' friends, guild or party members can also join the room.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: ★THANK YOU ALL★ 9th Anniversary Event Begins!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/02db8a5422907e9c4faf32de09791208193e5d3e.png
Thank you for playing Toram.

We are celebrating Toram Online's 9th Anniversary on 7/17/2024.
In order to thank you for your continued patronage, many celebration events will be held!

Toram Online will continue to evolve and bring you many more exciting contents even after the 9th Anniversary Event, so stay tuned as there's much more to come!

9th Anniversary Event Period
From: 07/11/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 08/29/2024 before the maintenance

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

9th Anniversary Arenas!
Win the Battle Against Bosses!!
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/10925e31c678680fd0c53d2cd04bc2f0ee7d4c1d.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/d46c6eb318b03a44e61731466cd7c49828ee5c2e.png[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/11188442a3e2f0761b7ab4a34339fafaeb828294.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c1a2f98185868413f3a946f2166d9d97a53f68d9.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
You can go to the Anniversary Arena from the wormhole in “"Sofya City", "El Scaro",  "Hora Diomedea", and "Draco Town".

During the event period, 9 types of Anniversary Arena appear as event maps and you can challenge many boss monsters!
The battles are totally different from the normal boss battles!

The boss battles from the 1st-8th Anniversary Event that can be challenged at the 1st-8th venue are also brought back!

What to Expect from the Upcoming EX Arena?!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f5cafd4eaae5f254916178c211accee4b4d3c69f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0f44359b0634924dd8f18e498e7be5f183b646b6.png[/td][/tr][/table]
You can get body armors and additional gears that are released to celebrate the 9th Anniversary at the new EX Arena!!

*A limited number of 9th Anniversary additional gears can also be obtained with the "Anniv Festive Ticket" you get from the 1st-8th venue.
*You can now let your mercenary, pet or partner join EX Arena.

Let's Open 9th Anniversary Boxes!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/05de2608ce6fd863c6abf2130b3b3bca00d0ff9b.png
During the Anniversary Event, players will get "9th Anniversary Box" when defeating boss monster which difficulty level can be selected.
Open the box and get random items!

*Mini bosses on normal maps such as Moonlight Potum and Arcoiris will not drop the box.
*Even after the period above, the items will not be deleted, and you can open them.

Epic Toram Birthday Emblem!!
You can get 4 types of "Toram Birthday!" emblem during the following period.
The emblems grant you special effects and rewards to enjoy the game more!

[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Toram Birthday! A[/td][td]Logged in the game.[/td][td]Ticket Piece x900[/td][/tr][tr][td]Toram Birthday! B[/td][td]Played more than 1 hour in total today.[/td][td]Victory Gem x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Toram Birthday! C[/td][td]Played more than 2 hours in total today.[/td][td]Fairy Sewing Tool x20[/td][/tr][tr][td]Toram Birthday! D[/td][td]Played more than 3 hours in total today.[/td][td]Orb Shard x300[/td][/tr][/table]

Toram Birthday Emblems Available Period
From: 07/17/2024 at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: 07/18/2024 at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*You can claim and receive emblems after clearing the conditions from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem].

9th Anniversary Daily Emblems!
Packed with Gorgeous Items!
Special daily emblems are available during the event period.
Play the game every day and complete all!

[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Rewards[/th][/tr][tr][td]9th Anniversary Celebration A[/td][td]Logged in to the game.[/td][td]Fairy Sewing Tool x 2[/td][/tr][tr][td]9th Anniversary Celebration B[/td][td]Defeated 100 monsters.[/td][td]Teleport Ticket x 9[/td][/tr][tr][td]9th Anniversary Celebration C[/td][td]Played for 1 hour today.[/td][td]Orb Shard x 90[/td][/tr][/table]

Available Period of the Emblems
From: 07/11/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 08/29/2024 before the maintenance

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*You can claim and receive emblems after clearing the conditions from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem].

Toram's 9th Anniversary Photo Contest
Call for Entries! Create, Snap, and Post!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/54edb42bc96d4ed886be63d33946d0e446c5b31d.png
Toram's 9th Anniversary Photo Contest is being held now and we are accepting submissions related to Toram Online (screenshot/illustration/handicraft)!

The winners will receive Orb x50 and gorgeous in-game items and their works will be showcased with commentaries on our official website, X, and Bemmo Channel.

Contest Schedule
Entry Period: Thursday, 07/11/2024 16:00 PM (JST/GMT+9) ~ Sunday, 08/25/2024 23:59 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Winners Announcement: Scheduled for late August-early September 2024
Prize Delivery:Scheduled for mid-September 2024

9th Anniversary Repost Campaign!
More Reposts Means More Rewards!
We are holding a Repost Campaign during the period below where we will give away gorgeous in-game items and buffs to all players according to the number of reposts we get!

[table][tr][th]No. of RePosts[/th][th]Present[/th][/tr][tr][td]1000RP[/td][td]Ticket Piece x100
Orb Shard x100[/td][/tr][tr][td]1,500RP[/td][td]EXP +25%
*EXP will increase during the specified period after the number of reposts has been tabulated.[/td][/tr][tr][td]2,000RP[/td][td]Fairy Paper Pattern x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]2,500RP[/td][td]EXP +25%
*EXP will increase during the specified period after the number of reposts has been tabulated.[/td][/tr][tr][td]3,000RP[/td][td]Adventurer's Diary x1[/td][/tr][/table]
We will give away all the items above if we reach 3000 reposts!

How to Join
You can see the tweet you need to retweet from our "Official Twitter Account" at the bottom left of the screen after starting the app or from [ Menu > News > Official News > X].

If you don't have a X account, take this opportunity to create one and join the campaign!

Campaign Period
Start: 7/19/2024 when the post to repost is posted
End: 7/23/2024 2:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)
[strike]Present Delivery Period: Late July to Late August 2024[/strike]
Present Delivery Period: 7/25/2024 after maintenance
Claim Period: 8/29/2024 before maintenance
Increased EXP Period: 7/25/2024 after maintenance to 8/29/2024 before maintenance

*Only players who start playing the game before the maintenance on Thursday, 7/25/2024 can receive the item.
*You can receive the gifts even if you don't repost.
*Please understand that the gifts and campaign period are subject to change.

Notes
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: "Anniversary Recipes" Available! Get 9th Anniversary Limited Equipment!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8458333d471ab4eecfa875adf6ee0232e1a78831.png
Examples of Equipment Craftable at the Blacksmith
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/80f8a31bf2305a9620ef24c00a0e988388c1392b.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9f755f4934b67be267f6ba75a06997b41fed30d9.png[/td][/tr][/table]
The recipes for powerful and stylish anniversary limited equipment are out now!
Challenge the boss battles in the arenas and collect the special items to create your powerful anniversary equipment at the blacksmiths or with your Smith Skills!

How to Create Items with Limited-Edition Recipes?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/79899ee14699824e32b26fb0ba215164fb950466.png
Talk to the Blacksmith in "Sofya City", "El Scaro" or "Hora Diomedea", tap "Create Equipment" and select "Limited-Time".

Let's Make Use of the "Mats Search" Feature!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/87692af6b7a54f319c75fd58c29665d39f1bee2d.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/5750e731aba9aea30fc872ebe4c6051dbffe29d7.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Use "Mats Search" to check the materials required in a crafting recipe.

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/af8bca780503d40b29479440fb087fb66e4a55ab.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6bd73b1ac5e78fc26370aba83bf0dbe634ee3373.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Besides, you can also tap the monster shown on the top of the mini map to see the list of items the monster drops.

It's a useful feature that will definitely make crafting items more convenient than ever, so please make use of it!

Available Period of the Recipes
From: 07/11/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 09/12/2024 before the maintenance

Notes
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Toram's 9th Anniversary Photo Contest: Call for Entries! Create, Snap, and Post!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/54edb42bc96d4ed886be63d33946d0e446c5b31d.png
We will be celebrating Toram Online's 9th Anniversary on 7/17/2024 and we have decided to hold Toram's 9th Anniversary Photo Contest to celebrate it!

Let's liven Toram Online's 9th Anniversary up by preserving the memories with your friends and picturing the epic moment of intense battle with a powerful monster through various forms of works related to Toram!

The winners will receive Orb x50 and gorgeous in-game items and their works will be showcased with commentaries on our official website, X, and Bemmo Channel.

We hope to receive as many entries as possible!

Contest Schedule
Entry Period: Thursday, 07/11/2024 16:00 PM (JST/GMT+9) ~ Sunday, 08/25/2024 23:59 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Winners Announcement: Scheduled for late August-early September 2024
Prize Delivery:Scheduled for mid-September 2024

How to Enter
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Prepare a piece of artwork (screenshot, illustration, or handicraft) related to Toram Online created by you.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Follow Toram's official X account (@toram_pr).[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Post a picture of it within the entry period and make sure to include the hashtag #ToramPhotoChallenge[/td][/tr][/table]
That's it!

Make Use of the View Mode Feature to Capture the Perfect Shot!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/241a764e9e927a1af3b8fccf74b69b93931e1ca7.pngPicture taken with normal "Screenshot"[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ada1501f0796326ce9e7511a29ef7c4b6f49284f.pngPicture taken with "Screenshot" in View Mode[/td][/tr][/table]
 By choosing the View Mode that you have added to the shortcut, you will be able to move the screen angle without moving your character.
 To take a picture in View Mode, you can use the usual "Screenshot" button or the key that you have set as the shortcut for screenshot.
 
Prizes & Awards
Suzuki P Award (3 winners)
Selected and awarded by Suzuki P, the producer of Toram Online.
Prizes: Orb x50, Anniversary Gem x1, Legendary XXX
*Legendary XXX will be decided randomly.

Pillow Kitagawa's Award (3 winners)
Selected and awarded by BeMMO Channel's MC Pillow Kitagawa.
Prizes: Orb x50, Anniversary Gem x1, Pillow Box x1

PR Potum's Award (6 winners)
Selected and awarded by Toram Online Operator Potum.
Prizes: Orb x50, Anniversary Gem x1

Notes
*Your submission will be deemed invalid if:
- You don't use the specified hashtags.
- We find out that you have submitted someone else's work.
- You submit your work past the entry period.
- Our team believes that your submission is inappropriate.
- The option to Receive Direct Messages from anyone is disabled.
- Your X Account is made Private.

*AI-generated illustrations will not be screened.
Please note that if the winning work is later found out to be an AI-generated illustration after the contest has ended, the award will be canceled.

*Only the winner has the right to claim the prize. The prize cannot be transferred to a third party.

*Depending on the number of submissions, the number of winners may increase.

*Please comply with X Terms of Service when you submit your work.

*Only screenshots (still images) will be screened.

*Screenshots that have been edited or modified are also allowed.

*You are allowed to submit multiple works.

*Screenshots that have been edited or modified are also allowed.

*Works that have been posted on social media in the past are also allowed.
（But not the works that have been submitted for previous contests)

*Hashtags are not case-sensitive.

*Only images in formats supported by X can be submitted.
*Please note that even if you win, your prize will be canceled if you are not following "Toram Online PR Potum's X account (@toram_pr)" when we announce the winners.

*The same submission will not win multiple awards.
However, you may win multiple awards if you have more than one submission.

*The copyright of the submitted work belongs to the applicant.

*Both the applicant and ASOBIMO, Inc. own the rights to use the submitted work.
All the submitted works including those that did not win any awards will be managed by ASOBIMO, Inc. and may also be used in our website, advertising media, social media, etc. without compensation.
By submitting your work, you confirm that you have read and agree to the conditions stated above.

*Please refrain from submitting contents that harm the image of a character, violate, or risk to violate public morals and social standards.

*A penalty for interference with our business may be applied if your action is deemed to be disrupting the progress of the contest intentionally.

*Please understand that the schedule may be subject to change.

*Any matters not specified in this contest shall conform to Toram Online's "Terms of Use" and "Privacy Policy".

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: June 21st at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: June 24th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: It's June and It's Time for the June Bride Event!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b1c8aad795eb62d3bcd8960a8cea4c70177bef82.png
The "June Bride" event allows you to join forces and trade with your close friends or guild members, thus improving interaction and helping you to build and develop your character.

June Bride Event Period
From: 06/13/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 07/05/2024 at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)

What's June Bride Event?
Players will be granted the event bonus below if there are 2 or more characters in the party regardless of gender.

Form a party to earn more EXP!
"EXP Gain +20%" bonus buff.

*The bonus from this campaign is not applicable to pets.
*The boost effect from this event will be stacked with the effect from Orb items and 30-Day Tickets.

Get Limited Treasure Box!
Furthermore, depending on the gender of the player's character, the player can get June Bride Event-limited Treasure Box when the boss is defeated.

A male/neutral A character will get the "Groom Box" and a female/neutral B character will get the "Bride Box".
The contents of the treasure boxes for male characters and those for female characters are different and various items can be obtained randomly.

Of all the items you can get, the "June Bride Limited Equipment" has the perfect design that is suitable for the groom and the bride for their wedding.

Let's Trade "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet"!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/34b38df6abfc2c9cb87d0b2fa08726a708f41440.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0b9cbefad51f35cd91bae26e04d82e6337b23863.png[/td][/tr][/table]
If you trade "Marriage Gift (Empty)" or "Toss Bouquet" with another adventurer or receive it as a gift during the June Bride Event, the item will become untradable and the "Selling Price" as well as the "Material Points" will greatly increase.

Why don't you take this opportunity and try trading them with your friends or guild members?

Let's redecorate Your Land!
Example of Craftable Furniture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6b9386f1d7d2c2efc8ae44a51f2fb7f10f7bfd3f.png
Items for Your Land that can be created with materials obtained from June Bride Event are available!

Why don't you take this chance to change your Land's design?
 
Notes
*Mercenaries, partners and pets are not counted as party members.
*Please note that "Groom Box" and "Bride Box" cannot be obtained from certain boss monsters.
*Only male characters can get the "Groom Box" and only female characters can get the "Bride Box".
*The "Groom Box" and the "Bride Box" will be removed through the maintenance held on 07/11/2024.
*The increased "Selling Price" and "Material Points" as well as the creator name of "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will be attached only if they are traded with another player or sent as a gift.
"Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will remain the same even if they are sold on the Consignment Board.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: May 24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: May 27th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: New Mini Game "Pet Racing" Implemented!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b3710a702e11b65a07fadae852c67249b254a5dd.png
Is the Pino Cup going to be held for real?! A mini game where your pets can run in a race in Sofya City has been released!  
Use the pets you have raised to dodge obstacles along the racing track and try to reach the finish line as fast as possible!

What's "Pet Racing"?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/78ec22ea8a918b0f7c5ffaad2e717960a7a16c8d.png
Place the furniture "Pet Racing Track" on Your Land and set it to Public mode to play "Pet Racing".

First, you need to have a pet that has been disciplined (Discipline 100%) and not groggy. 
The pet that meets the condition can join the race.

Game Modes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/772d2271043888964f4aef369c2252fcde656e6f.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Racing by yourself[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Racing with other players on the same land.
*Your time will not be recorded on this mode.
*The owner of the land will be the room leader.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Racing with party members only
The race is limited to members of the party.[/td][/tr][/table]

Start Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/cf3e9362a97920ad867e85763fe7402adcab6f3f.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Change the pet to join the race.

The pet must not be groggy and the Discipline must be 100%. 
The pet can only be changed to the pet that meets the same condition.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Configure detailed settings for the race.
Please see below for details.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Start the race.[/td][/tr][/table]

Race Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/09029151b9a2d383eb9c9ee1dcf021c3825eaa53.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Change the racing track.
You can select Sofya City: Track 1-3.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Decide whether to have the obstacles placed at fixed or random locations. 
Your time will be recorded if fixed is selected.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]If you choose to have the obstacles placed at fixed locations, the record for the corresponding track will be displayed.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Show or hide pet's stats.[/td][/tr][/table]

・Pet's Stats in Pet Racing
The performance of your pets in Pet Racing changes depending on their stats and personality!
Ex: The pet's personality affects its acceleration and maximum ability.

Find the fastest companion by raising and training different types of pets!

Let's Enjoy Racing!
Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/41792986bcdeaa8f38e1dff5491acdca63bbc5b8.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]It shows the current speed.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Stamina Bar
It will decrease when the pet dashes or runs into an obstacle.
When the stamina bar becomes 0, the pet will enter a burnout state and it will slow down for a certain period of time.

The pet will naturally recover its stamina as it runs.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Accelerate
Stamina will be consumed when used.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Jump
Use it to jump over an obstacle.[/td][/tr][tr][th]5[/th][td]Press it together with the directional control (left or right) to perform a sidestep.
Use it to dodge obstacles.[/td][/tr][tr][th]6[/th][td]Turn on or turn off camera auto-follow.[/td][/tr][tr][th]7[/th][td]Map Display
Slide on the map to change viewpoint.[/td][/tr][tr][th]8[/th][td]Use it to end the race.
*If you are not the room leader and you choose to quit in the middle of the race, then you will not be able to join another race until the race you quit is finished.[/td][/tr][/table]

Actions
・Constant Speed
The pet will move on its own.
Constant speed is the speed generated without the player's intervention.

・Acceleration & Deceleration 
Dash to accelerate.
As the pet runs, it will slow down. Its stamina will be consumed when it runs into an obstacle and the speed will go back to constant speed.

Dash can also be used consecutively, but a lot of stamina will be consumed.

Obstacles & Items Along the Track
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/81eebfe6dd9b67be548fda04578cae9383405879.png
The pet can dodge obstacles placed along the track by performing actions such as dash and jump.
You need to perform different actions for your pet to dodge different obstacles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a60d20df6b4fd79816080579cc9b76b3d9feee21.png

The EX Skill "Color Saving" of Alchemy Skills will be unlocked if "Technical Synthesis I" Lv1 or higher has been acquired.
The option to "Save Color" will only be shown when the equipment has color info. Multiple colors can be selected and saved.

The option "Fetch Color" allows you to use the colors you saved to transmute equipment.
