notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: April 26th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: April 30th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [EDIT]About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/80395f4719b3e8c012391dbca2468d4c18a39a33.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

We have performed several adjustments for the balances of the existing skills during the maintenance on 4/18/2024.
Along with skill balance adjustments, skill & stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 4/18/2024 after the maintenance
Until: 5/3/2024 5:00 AM(JST/GMT+9)

The Number of Resets Available
[EDIT]
A few bugs were found after the recent skill adjustments. Because of that, we have decided to provide additional free resets under the following condition.

Eligibility
Accounts that logged in and received free resets between 4/18/2024 after maintenance and 4/25/2024 before maintenance are eligible.

Additional Resets
1 free skill/stats reset will be added per no. of character slots owned (as of 4/25/2024 before the maintenance).
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, then a total of 10 skill/stats resets will be added.
[hr][/hr] 
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 04/18/2024 before the maintenance) x 3
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 30 times in total.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fffa507dc45916c00b22335280f5a62f523936f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/beed805ee680a96d177cb4c95c2d852f523aa2fa.png[/td][/tr][/table]
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"]

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/eecfea4b5a5599b330a0b7da9e108be50057f1a3.png
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"]

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Library is Here![/td][td]NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Skill Balance Adjustment
notes.content:
Skill balance will be adjusted during the update on Thursday, April 18, 2024.
For more details, please refer to the following descriptions.

Skill Balance Adjustment
Blade Skills
■Aura Blade
Added a passive effect that increases the power of "Buster Blade" when it is used with a one-handed sword.
*Not applicable when using dual swords.


Shot Skills
■Twin Storm
We have fixed an issue where the number of times used was not consumed correctly under certain conditions, resulting in discrepancies with the server.

■Parabola Cannon
When triggered at the target marked by Retrograde Shot, it will now fire at the target's feet.
*Not applicable for arrow throwing.


Magic Skills
■Magic: Storm
Increased skill power per hit.

■Magic: Guardian Beam
Although not being targeted directly, additional attacks will now be activated in sync with casting as long as it is within range.
*The timing of the activation remains the same.
The number of activations greatly increases according to skill level.

■Qadal
Removed the added buff count for Magic: Burst and the increased charge effect for Magic: Magic Cannon.
Added an effect that increases the power of magic skills according to the battle duration when MaxHP is decreased because of this skill (overburdened state)
only if there is no buff effect (MP Cost of the next skill activated is halved/ Guaranteed Critical) consumed.
The more overburdened you are, the higher the limit of the power increase will be.
The battle duration will be counted even though Qadal is not used, but it will be reset if you get knocked out or the overburdened state is resolved (buff time's up).

■Magic: Burst
The count limit display of burst now changes according to CSPD.
If the count is always 0/0, the buff will not be shown.
The frontal invincibility when the skill is active is changed to normal invincibility and it continues to last for 1 second even after the skill ends if a staff is equipped or the main equipment is a magic device.

■Magic: Magic Cannon
Slightly added the charge increase due to skill activation if a staff is equipped or the main weapon is a magic device.
When charged over 100%, charge speed will be reduced by half, but it may pierce through Guard.

■Chronos Shift
Removed the ability to consume HP (with a KO risk) when there isn't enough MP. Now it can't be activated when there isn't enough MP.
Adjusted the cooldown. (Compared to the cooldown before adjustment, it is now even longer if the level is low, and shorter if the level is high)

■Enchanted Barriers
Reworked the skill. Now not usable if the subweapon is a magic device.
Changed to a barrier skill with a durability value depending on INT that is placed at your feet. (for the user only)
While inside the barrier, the barrier HP can be consumed to reduce or nullify the damage taken. (lower damage absorption rate for close-range attacks and certain attacks).
While inside the barrier, you will also not flinch while casting. Aggro from MP consumption will be reduced. Buff count of Magic: Burst increases. The cast time of Magic: Finale becomes shorter. 
While inside the barrier, an effect to keep the overburdened state from Qadal at 99% before becoming 100% or more is applied 1 time only, the durability of the barrier will greatly decrease and buff effects cannot be obtained.
Reactivating Enchanted Barriers will only change the barrier position while the durability will remain the same.
Restoring MP inside the barrier will also restore the barrier's durability.


Martial Skills
■Asura Aura
As the character will become completely invincible in all situations by just using this skill consecutively, the skill has been changed so that the invincibility gets removed when Asura Aura ends. 
After Asura Aura ends, if the buff effect still remains, the presence of Asura will be felt and it will continue to increase power (less than when it is visible)/ increase skill power/ increase critical rate.

■Flash Blink
It now applies to close range attacks.

■Energy Control
Can no longer coexist with the buffs from "Enchanted Burst". (obtaining the buffs from Energy Control will remove them)


Dual Sword Skills
■Storm Reaper
The powerful buff effect that was originally designed to prevent DPS drop because of jumping back for a long distance can apparently be boosted if there is a wall that obstructs the jump. As this behavior is different from the intended mechanism,
an adjustment has been made so that the amount of buff effect will change according the the distance traveled back.

■Lunar Misfortune
Removed the effect of always being a close-range attack.
Added an MP recovery effect per hit of the rain of blades that happens due to emergency withdrawal (intended by the player).
DEX will now boost power regardless of the activation distance.
Considering the fast attack, long range, emergency withdrawal (intended by the player) and shortened animation recovery (from skill) which make it powerful, the impact of DEX has been reduced to balance it.
The buff effect of Orbit Reaper has been halved and changed to increased long-range attack power.


Halberd Skills
■Draconic Charge
Fixed the problem where the power would decline because the proration that changes from the first hit affects the second hit.

■Tornado Lance
Tornado power (buff stack) now will not be consumed if an attack is successfully evaded not with the help of this skill's effect.


Mononofu Skills
■Hasso Happa
Regardless of the distance of the effect, it now applies to close range attacks.

■Shadowless Slash
Regardless of the activation distance, it now applies to close range attacks. 


Shield Skills
■Belagerung
It now applies to close/long range attacks.
*The appropriate one will be applied according to activation distance.


Dagger Skills
■Knife Combat
Power will now increase based on dagger's ATK.
Greatly increased normal attack power and Attack MP Recovery during Knife Combat.

■Flincher Knife
Power will now increase based on dagger's ATK.


Magic Blade Skills
■Enchant Sword
Removed unsheathing attribute.
Reduced the power during Enchant Burst Sword.

■Enchanted Spell
We have fixed an issue where even the element of the skills with fixed element also changed because of the magic device.

■Enchanted Burst
The buffs from Enchant Burst Sword can no longer be obtained with the Enchanted Grip that can be activated when switching to physical properties due to Conversion.
The buffs from Enchant Burst Sword can no longer be obtained when the buffs of Energy Control or Annihilator have been obtained.

■Dual Bringer
Extended the duration of buffs that depend on magic device. (at least 10 seconds guaranteed regardless of the magic device stats)
The buffs of magic skills will also be reflected now for one-handed sword only. The magic skills activated will be changed to the element of the magic device.
The buff count of Enchanted Burst will be accumulated while the buff of Magic: Finale, Magic: Burst, Magic: Magic Cannon or Magic: Crash is active.
The STR or INT (the higher one only) bonus which was previously granted if the target's element is your weak element and the target is inflicted with [Weaken], has been adjusted and now it will be granted even if it is not your weak element.

■Union Sword
The power has been reduced, but it has been changed back to an ATK/MATK combined attack.
Removed the effect that reduces damage taken while active.
Reduced the power of the derivative skill, but skill power will increase as MP is consumed.
Slightly narrowed the attack range when the derivative skill is used with something other than a one-handed sword.


Crusher Skills
■Annihilator
Can no longer coexist with the buffs from "Enchanted Burst". (obtaining the buffs from Annihilator will remove them)


Wizard Skills
■Lightning
Regardless of the activation distance, it now applies to long range attacks. 

■Meteor Strike
Regardless of the distance of the effect, it now applies to close/long range attacks (whichever is higher).

■Crystal Laser
It now applies to close/long range attacks.
*The appropriate one will be applied according to activation distance.


Ninja Skills
■Demon Wind Shuriken
Regardless of the distance of the effect, it now applies to close/long range attacks (whichever is higher).

■Cloning
When the skill "Mortal Surrogate" is activated, you will now become invincible for 1 second.

Other Changes
・Changed the max effect of the equipment stat "Guard Break" from 50% to 100%. (*1)
・Changed the max effect of the equipment stat "Anticipate" from 50% to 100%. (*1)
・Changed the way the equipment stat "ATK UP (●%)" is calculated.
・Changed the way the equipment stat "MATK UP (●%)" is calculated.
・Adjusted the Unsheathe Power of the crysta "Odelon Machina". (*2)
・Adjusted the Unsheathe Power of the crysta "Tappler". (*2)
・Adjusted the Unsheathe Power of the crysta "Lilicarolla". (*2)
・You can now see the details of the skill that has not been unlocked yet.

(*1)"Guard Break" and "Anticipate" still won't affect special "Guard/Evasion" during game event cutscenes. 
[strike](*2)A free 100% crysta removal feature will be displayed on the Edit Crysta page during the reset period for the crystas that have been adjusted.[/strike]
(*2)A feature to 100% remove the crystas that have been adjusted for free will appear on the Edit Crysta page for a certain period of time.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From: March 29th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: March 31st at 11:59 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Mini Game "Fishing" Is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7a0aefaa019fd1776496cf819f102ee7a9dddede.png
You can now play the mini game "Fishing" to experience and enjoy fishing in the Toram world.
Make sure to play the "Fishing" mini game as you can catch various kinds of fish and get exclusive items!

Intro to "Fishing" Mini Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/cc7bacde0a2a352b570292b0fb32abbeb85c9ce4.png
Once you have created the furniture "Fishing Workbench", you will be able to play the mini game. You will see the option "Fishing Gear" in the Character menu and "Start Fishing" will be added to shortcuts.

How to Use "Fishing Workbench"
Place the "Fishing Workbench" on Your Land and change it to View Mode. Select the icon displayed on the top to create fishing rod and view your catch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/fca9310c6b1ef598b056c1b65fafeda85f388bde.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]You can increase the storage space for your catch using Orbs or Spinas.
The more slots you add, the more Spinas will be required later.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]You ca create a fishing rod using Material Points.
Please refer to "Fishing Rod" below for details.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Sunken Items are items you may get through fishing when the conditions are met.
You can check the infomation of the items you may get and the conditions to obtain the information.

 *You can keep the list of sunken items for up to 1 month.[/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]You can check the date and size of the fish you have caught. You can also process them into Ingredient Points.
*You can only process them into Ingredient Points on Your Land.
Please refer to "Processing Fish" below for details.[/td][/tr][/table]

Fishing Rod
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/4b22e7fa3dcdeaf1151cc5c148df732d77e6c890.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/04b99167039ab0ab104bc64a57c6d1b44f811dd7.png[/td][/tr][/table]
You can have up to 3 Fishing Rods.
Use at least 100 or at most 1000 Material Points to create a fishing rod.

Fishing Rod Parameters
[table][tr][th]Parameter[/th][th]Effect[/th][/tr][tr][td]Rod[/td][td]The hit zone becomes larger.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snell[/td][td]The reel meter depletes more slowly when you are out of the hit zone.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sinker[/td][td]The hit zone becomes less slippery.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bobber[/td][td]First contact with the fish takes place faster.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hook[/td][td]Fight time becomes longer.[/td][/tr][/table]

The paramaters of the fishing rod change depending on the number of Material points used. Allocate and adjust the number of Material Points to create the perfect fishing rod for yourself!

Broken Fishing Rod
・Broken Fishing Rod
The fishing rod will be broken and cannot be used anymore when the durability becomes 0.
The broken fishing rod won't disappear. You can use it to create a new fishing rod.

When a new fishing rod is created from a broken one, a bonus is applied to the highest parameter plus 1 random parameter of the broken fishing rod.

*If there are multiple parameters that are the highest, two of them will be selected randomly.

Switching Fishing Rod
You can choose or switch the fishing rod to use from  Menu > Character > Fishing Gear.

Let's Enjoy Fishing!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/368e2e1b1134cf91f2a00efb37eca197aa93c998.png
Add "Start Fishing" to shortcuts and use it on the map where fishing is available to start fishing.

Examples of Maps Where "Fishing" Is Available
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/73d27ca05d80d0e3bb965ab1790b1052526b2707.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/de86de8e1e6812fbed1ef8cabc8bff2e0006e2c4.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Sofya City
Korda Basin
Athema Ruined Town: Area 2

*Fishing is basically not available in dungeon areas, but there are some exceptions.

Controls & Guides for "Fishing" Mini Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/446f252040233885b435e2fe240ca26999abc14f.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Check the fish you have caught.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]You can cast bait to increase the chance of fish getting hooked. The effect of the bait will diminish each time a fish gets hooked.
The effect on the current map will be lost if you cast bait on another map.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Use View Mode[/td][/tr][/table]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3da8f85aa1f9a388771c144af6507cce592e138e.png
An icon will appear above the character if a fish gets hooked.
Tap the icon to start the mini game.

*The icon remains active for 30 minutes. You can start the mini game at any time while the icon is active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9eedf87159ea1c6df684135ef5d3b28f8e7d39d0.png
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Time Limit (Fight Time) of the Mini Game
If the time limit (fight time) of the mini game reaches 0 second, the fish that gets hooked will get away.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]The Fish That Gets Hooked and the Hit Zone.
You can charge the reel bar by timing the hit zone and the moving fish.
The hit zone can be moved to the left and right.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]Reel Meter
Charge the reel meter to pull the rod.

You can reel the fish in by pulling the rod when the reel meter is fully charged. [/td][/tr][tr][th]4[/th][td]Charge the reel meter to use it.[/td][/tr][/table]

Processing Fish
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/de6bd99a716148b8401add3661d0c2b1ee3f192a.png
The fish you have caught are stored in the cooler.
You can process the fish into Ingredient Points on Your Land using the furniture "Fishing Workbench" or from [Menu > Character > Fishing Gear].

Notes
*The availability of the mini game and the content of the rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: New Skill Tree "Partisan Skills" Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/aa0d9bbc2e15433a0a38cccc2748145e873d9660.png
We have released a new skill tree, "Partisan Skills", and added new "Blade Skills", "Shot Skills", and "Assassin Skills" through the maintenance on 3/14/2024.
Furthermore, adjustments have been made to some skills.

Let's Learn New Skills!

How to Acquire the Skills
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"　　　　[/td][/tr][/table]
You can acquire the skill tree from the NPC "Lilulu" in the library in "Sofya City" with Spinas when your level meets the requirement.
The skill tree can also be acquired by using the item specified respectively.

Level Requirement　Blade Skills Shot Skills
[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]Lv10 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv30 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv70 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv4[/td][td]Lv150 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv5[/td][td]Lv240 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Level Requirement　Assassin Skills
[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]Lv15 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv35 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv125 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv4[/td][td]Lv205 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Level Requirement　Partisan Skills
[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]With the item "[Book of Partisan]"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv160 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv250 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

Blade Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Hammer Slam[/td][td]Performs a narrow-range attack around the targets
as if you are slamming them down. Guarantees a
critical hit on targets immobilized by Flinch or
other status ailments. MP Cost becomes 0 if used
consecutively.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Cleaving Attack[/td][td]Swings the sword horizontally to deal with
multiple opponents. If 2 or more targets are
involved, the power will increase proportionally
and consumed MP will be restored.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Storm Blaze[/td][td]Attacks enemies in a straight line with an aerial
slash. Wind Power will accumulate when a normal
attack hits. Wind Power is consumed upon skill
activation. Power, attack range, and MP recovery
increase according to the amount consumed.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv4
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Garde Blade[/td][td]A defense technique using a two-handed sword.
Boosts Physical/Magic Resistance and improves
Guard ability for 70 seconds. Recovers Guard Power
a bit when the buff is applied.
Overwriting won't trigger this recovery.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv5
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Ogre Slash[/td][td]Deals damage to the target and after a short
while, causes an explosion at the target's feet,
dealing additional damage. If the conditions are
met, Ogre Power will be accumulated and consumed
upon skill activation to increase the power and
buff.[/td][/tr][/table]

Shot Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv5
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Quick Loader[/td][td]Activates Cross Fire and increases its charge by
1 level if is not fully charged.

This skill is not overwritten.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Element Starter[/td][td]The element of bow or bowgun will be activated at
the same time as the arrow.
*Not valid for dual element skills.
Gets a small recovery barrier each time you deal
damage to targets with the element you are weak to.[/td][/tr][/table]

Assassin Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Venom Injection[/td][td]An assassination technique by applying poison to
your weapon. Consumes your HP to gain the chance
to inflict poison during normal attacks.
The chance depends on the stats of dagger,
ninjutsu scroll and changes based on Critical or Graze.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Corrosive Poison[/td][td]Enables the stacking of poison with Venom
Injection (max +2). If it turns into enhanced
poison due to the stacking, the player's attack
will also be able to inflict poison damage.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Venom Thief[/td][td]Absorbs the corrosive poison from the target to
restore your own HP and get rid of the poison
status. If it is enhanced poison, MP will also be
restored. If not poisoned, you will get an effect
that prevents you from getting poisoned.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv4
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Death Reception[/td][td]Uses the poison absorbed with Venom Thief to
inflict damage and Deadly Poison to the target.
Depending on the poison used, damage that inflicts
poison to your surroundings will also be generated additionally.[/td][/tr][/table]

Partisan Skills
Below are the skills added.

Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]L Boomerang[/td][td]Throws Lepage's boomerang sword. It will only hit
the target and return after traveling a certain
distance with the chance of hitting the target again.
The skill will do no damage without a boomerang.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Healing Shot[/td][td]Consumes your own HP (min 100) and shoots a
straight healing arrow toward the furthest party
member. The heal amount is different for
mercenary, partner, and pet.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Frontliner[/td][td]The determination to never back down. Increases
your own Aggro and raises the increase of Aggro
for 60 seconds. Additionally gains Physical
Barrier according to the number of nontarget members.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]L Boomerang II[/td][td]Throws the boomerang while moving backward,
however, it is less powerful.
Without a boomerang, you will only move backward.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Arrow Sharpening[/td][td]Enhances the next normal attack used.

STR increases Physical Pierce,
AGI increases Action Speed, and
DEX increases critical performance.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Frontliner II[/td][td]Gains Magic Barrier too when gaining Physical
Barrier from the skill "Frontliner". Additionally,
there is a passive effect that increases MaxHP
permanently in line with skill acquisition.[/td][/tr][/table]

Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]L Boomerang III[/td][td]Critical Rate and Physical Pierce go up.
The boomerang will go after the target. It will
return after traveling a certain distance or
colliding with an obstacle with the chance of
hitting the target again.
The skill will do no damage without a boomerang.[/td][/tr][tr][td]N Dragon Tooth[/td][td]The Dragon Tooth invented by Nino. Attacks the
target and moves backward. Slightly raises the
piercing power of the next skill used.
Acquiring the skill "Dragon Tooth" will increase
the power further.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Survival Instinct[/td][td]Increases MaxHP and Fractional Damage Reduction
for 20 seconds when a party member gets knocked out.
*Doesn't activate if knocked out due to certain conditions.[/td][/tr][/table]

Skill Adjustments
 The skills below have been adjusted.
 
Mononofu Skills
・Hasso Happa
Adjusted the ability when the skill changes.

A new quest for White Day Event, "Give and Take", has been added.
Furthermore, the White Day limited quests from previous years are also being brought back!

Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Cookie" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Blue Wrapping Ribbon"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d097cb7377e06065637892d19ff4cdb9e329602.png
During the event period, you can create "Heart Cookie" by collecting the "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Cookie" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Cookie" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Cookie"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6d8dc6ce99eaf53172e7f056738deed055ad166a.png
If you trade "Heart Cookie" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its MP healing effect will increase by 10 times.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for White Day.

How about giving them to your friends or guild members who always help you out?

Notes
*You cannot obtain "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" from special event maps such as Guild Maze or Challenge Dungeon.
*The creator's name of the "Heart Cookie" will be displayed only when it is traded during the event period.
"Heart Cookie"'s MP healing effect increases only when it is traded during the event period.
The aforementioned changes will not apply to the "Heart Cookie" when sent via gift or sold with the Consignment system.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b28900cba43ba6796f9ccda50782ba02d329471b.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c671faad3ed3277828b0dd35dd341d29f09667d0.png[/td][/tr][/table]
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Let's redecorate Your Land!
Example of Craftable Furniture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/61cea741e3f2a438e6de5662fbd9c1de12d2a7b7.png
Items for Your Land that can be created with materials obtained from White Day Event are available!
Why don't you take this chance to change your Land's design?

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:February22nd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:February26th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Limited Event: "Snowball Fight" Released! Hit Snowballs!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/afa309bbc2685ba6a076219765310c3b38f441d3.png
Now you can play "Snowball Fight" in the world of Toram Online for a limited period of time after the maintenance 2/15/2024!
 Use and exchange the "Snowball Points" you get from "Snowball Fight" for rare items that are exclusive to this event!

Make sure to play it with your jolly good friends or guild members and enjoy the exciting game!

"Snowball Fight" Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/15/2024
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/11/2024

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

What is Snowball Fight?
Players are divided into 2 teams and compete the number of snowballs they hit within 3 minutes.

Tips for Snowball Fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/97c11ad42831ad2de3bc63c8baf116be862d108b.png
You can access the mini-game venue from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Go to snowball fight venue" at Save Point.

Also, you can go to Save Point from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Back to Town" from the mini-game venue.

Overview
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Tap "I'm ready!!" after moving to the snowball fight field.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]The game will start with selected players via auto-matching.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]The winner is the team that holds more HP than the other.
Snowball Points will increase a little and you will get 1 Ice & Snow Bucket if you win.
[/td][/tr][/table]
*You cannot get the item if your bag is full.
*"Snow Bear Box" that you can get from Prize Exchange has a low chance to appear too from "Ice & Snow Bucket".

Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/76f45b1a60e3e3ec8f76b67b7c2722579431dba1.png
[table][tr][th]HP[/th][td]It decreases if you are hit by opponents.
Blue HP shows allied team's HP, red shows opponent team's HP.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Make[/th][td]You can sit down and create snowballs.
The more you hold snowballs, the longer it takes to create a snowball.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Throw[/th][td]You can throw a snowball.
Snowballs are thrown toward the "+" mark in front of the screen.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Auto[/th][td]You can throw a snowball to a player within the range and sight.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Dodge[/th][td]You can dodge snowballs by quickly moving a short distance.
If you are holding snowballs, you may lose them.[/td][/tr][/table]
* All throwing motions will become slower if you are in the enemy's zone.

Tips
Identify teams by the color indicated beneath each player.
HP is shared by all players in the same team.

About Frostbite and Respawn
If you get hit by a snowball, you will flinch and get frostbite that causes the screen to freeze for a little bit. If you get another hit in this condition, you will tumble and the screen will continue to freeze. Furthermore, if you get a third hit, you will freeze to death. After the death animation is shown, you will be taken back to the starting point and you lose 200 HP.

You will heal or return to the previous stage of frostbite if you don't get hit for 12 seconds. 
You will be invincible for a few seconds when you flinch or tumble.

Snowball Fight gets more exciting with items!!
Treasure Boxes Appear on the Snowball Fight Field!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0aede5225772860167647fda563a89fb45852975.png
You can get a "30-second Buff Item" by tapping the treasure box that appears on the Snowball Fight field!

[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Buff[/th][/tr][tr][td]Ice Meteor[/td][td]Ice chunks fall if you place a snowball on the ground![/td][/tr][tr][td]Ice Barrier[/td][td]No frostbite for up to 3 hits![/td][/tr][tr][td]Team Rescue[/td][td]Fully recover from frostbite.Team HP restored![/td][/tr][tr][td]Jumbo Ball[/td][td]Snowballs become bigger![/td][/tr][tr][td]Triple[/td][td]Snowballs thrown become 3![/td][/tr][/table]
Also, you can steal the buff from knocking down a buffed player!

Have fun using the items and use of them well to lead your team to victory!!

Snowball Fight Limited Special Daily Emblems Available!
Emblems that give you Ticket Pieces and other items will be available during the event period below.

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems
[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (Participate)[/td][td]Play Snowball Fight 2 times
Join from Terminal[/td][td]Revive Droplet x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (1st Victory)[/td][td]Win Snowball Fight once.[/td][td]Ticket Piece x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Ticket Bonus[/td][td]Obtain a 30-Day Ticket.[/td][td]Ice & Snow Bucket x2[/td][/tr][/table]
Win the snowball fight and get gorgeous items every day!

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems Available Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/15/2024
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/11/2024

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*Emblems can be received when the conditions are met from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem. ].

Notes
*The battle begins after all the party members tap "I'm ready!!".
*The snowballs made during the previous match cannot be used.
*If matchmaking fails within the time limit after tapping "I'm ready!!", you will return to waiting mode to tap "I'm ready!!" again.
*Ranking based on the number of snowball you threw does not affect your win or loss.
*You will not be able to tap a new treasure box to get an additional buff when you still have a buff that is active.
*If you knock down a buffed player from the opponent's team while having an active buff, the buff stolen from the player will be granted to one of your team members.
However, if all players in your team already have a buff that is active, the stolen buff will disappear.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

A new quest for Valentine's Day Event, "This Year's Sweets Are Safe & Worry-Free", has been added.
Furthermore, the Valentine's Day limited quests from previous years are also being brought back!

Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Chocolate" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Red Wrapping Ribbons"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/091891d5f6637d30f348867b337c8187c4bc5269.png
During the event period, you can create "Heart Chocolate" by collecting the "Red Wrapping Ribbons" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Chocolate" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Chocolate" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Chocolate"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/097b9bff9ab9fc491af26e98ea7e88d7961df157.png
If you trade "Heart Chocolate" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its HP healing effect will greatly increase.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for Valentine's Day.

Give it directly to the one and only important person of yours with love!

Notes
*You cannot obtain "Red Wrapping Ribbon" from special event maps such as Guild Maze or Challenge Dungeon.
*The creator's name of the "Heart Chocolate" will be displayed only when it is traded during the event period.
"Heart Chocolate"'s HP healing effect increases only when it is traded during the event period.
The aforementioned changes will not apply to the "Heart Chocolate" when sent via gift or sold with the Consignment system.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ca13614070a37b2ef95e3ff4e650394670369edf.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/03cc2ed7463b53741fe333b81accea1ae424b9ef.png[/td][/tr][/table]

Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Let's Get in the Valentine's Day Mood!!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/07e8e01d3a6700169abe3c37ea995841b7426669.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2642a8cc89f3089ed0ae9a80f7219e4e121ff904.png[/td][/tr][/table]

Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:January 26th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:January 29th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

[4P Party] + [Secondary Party A (2P)] + [Secondary Party B (2P)].

*Raid Battle is available after completing Story Mission: "Chaotic Truth".
*When another party is joining in the battle, all the party members' HP will show up on the left of the screen as "Secondary Party".

*Skills that affect party members such as Support Skill: "High Cycle" and Shield Skill: "Guardian" affect only the members in your party during raid battles.

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.

You can challenge it as many times as you want during the event period as long as you meet the requirements and are able to pay the participation fee.

You can get gorgeous rewards everytime you win a battle, so try your best to win all the battles!

3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:December 22nd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:December 25th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:November 24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:November 27th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Skill Adjustments
The skills below have been adjusted.

Tenryu Ransei
It has been adjusted so that proration won't happen when using it consecutively.

Garyou Tensei
"Bouncing Blade" and "Nukiuchi Sennosen" will now accumulate Garyou Tensei's buff.
Added the effect that increases the final damage of Mononofu skills to Garyou Tensei's buff.
If the damage reduction buff from the activation of Garyou Tensei is active, the final damage increase of Mononofu skills will remain at its maximum effect regardless of the current value.

Kasumisetsu Getsuka
The power has been raised.
The power of the derivative skill "Tenryu Ransei: Zanyu" has been raised.

Dauntless
The point count will go down by a certain percentage when fighting a field boss.
The count will continue to go down when not fighting the boss.
Added the effect that increases the power of "Tenryu Ransei" from 50 Dauntless points.

Vanquisher
Shooting range increased to 8m.
Due to this change, the equipment properties "Close Range Power" and "Long Range Power" have been adjusted to refer to the higher value.

Flash Blink
Changed to normal proration.

Geyser Kick
Adjusted to give physical penetration bonus regardless of activation distance.

Shield Repair
Shortened the charging time.

Belagerung
The power of each attack has been increased and the duration of the debuff has been extended.

Advanced Familia
Adjusted the time and level for familiar to act unpredictably.
Added a passive effect that increases the power of "Lightning", "Blizzard", and "Meteor Strike"according to the level acquired.

Homing Shot
Adjusted the number of shots according to the level acquired.

Multiple Hunt/Triple Ace Shots
Adjusted so that the buff effect will be activated just by using the skill.

Multiple Hunt/Sharp Sniper
Added DEX boost to the power of the skills.

 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:October 27nd at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:October 30th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/80395f4719b3e8c012391dbca2468d4c18a39a33.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

Along with skill balance adjustments, skill & stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 9/28/2023 after the maintenance
Until: 10/6/2023 5:00 AM(JST/GMT+9)

The Number of Resets Available
You can reset skills and stats up to 4 times in total.

There was an error in the information written previously.
We apologize for the confusion caused.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"]
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fffa507dc45916c00b22335280f5a62f523936f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/beed805ee680a96d177cb4c95c2d852f523aa2fa.png[/td][/tr][/table]

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/eecfea4b5a5599b330a0b7da9e108be50057f1a3.png
For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.content:

You can acquire the skill tree from the NPC "Lilulu" in the library in "Sofya City" with Spinas when your level meets the requirement.
The skill tree can also be acquired by using the item specified respectively.

Level Requirement　Magic Blade Skills
[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]With the item "[Book of Magic Warrior]"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv60 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv120 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv4[/td][td]Lv180 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv5[/td][td]Lv260 or more[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][th]Skill Tree[/th][th]Character[/th][/tr][tr][td]Lv1[/td][td]With the item "[Book of Unarmed]"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv2[/td][td]Lv100 or more[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lv3[/td][td]Lv250 or more[/td][/tr][/table]


Magic Blade Skills
Below are the skills added.
 
Lv1
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Siphon Barrier[/td][td]A defense technique converted into mana through a barrier.
Reduces physical/magic damage received during the skill and slightly restores MP. The amount
restored increases if magic damage gets reduced.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lv2
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Teleport[/td][td]A technique to dodge attacks by instantly moving to another point.
While casting Teleport, press a direction key to instantly move to that direction.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Siphon Recall[/td][td]Gets an additional status that continues to restore MP when damage is successfully reduced by Siphon Barrier.
The heal amount changes based on the value obtained from Siphon Barrier.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lv4
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Float Dash[/td][td]Urgently deploys magic device for high-speed flight.
Movement speed greatly increases for 10 seconds in exchange for being unable to perform a normal attack.
The effect ends when any skill is activated.
MP Cost of the activated skill is halved.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lv5
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Dual Bringer[/td][td]Keeps ATK and MATK high through resonance during the effect duration that depends on the ability of magic device.
Gets a critical bonus when attacking a weakened target.
This skill effect is only for Magic Blade Skills.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Union Sword[/td][td]A secret technique of wielding a colossal sword created with mana.
Performs a wide range attack ina straight line.
When under the enhancement effect of Enchanted Burst,
it will activate quickly by consuming its effect duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magic Skin[/td][td]The refinement value of magic device will have the same damage reduction effect as that of shield.
Furthermore, the more MP left, the more often physical/magic damage will be reduced.[/td][/tr][/table]


Bare Hand Skills
 Below are the skills added.
 
Lv3
[table][tr][th]Skill[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr][tr][td]Earthshaker[/td][td]Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon isequipped.
Get a barrier according to the qi accumulated by this skill.
Increases all elemental advantages, physical pierce, and stability.
The effect ends when Internal Elixir is used.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Miracle Comeback[/td][td]When Internal Elixir is not activated and you get knocked out,
it may auto-activate and restore your HP.
Once activated, it won't reactivate for some time.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hidden Talent[/td][td]If there are no slots, just hold them.
Equips 3 crystas and get the ability of the 2 corresponding crystas when Lion Rage/Raving Storm/Internal Elixir activates.
[/td][/tr][/table]



Skill Adjustments
 The skills below have been adjusted.

Magic Blade Skills
・Magic Warrior Mastery
Lowered ATK penalty exclusively for OHS has been alleviated.

・Ether Flare
Stats revised and now it will activate with your weak element.
Due to this adjustment, the effect of the gem case "Universal Ether Flare" has been changed.

・Conversion
Added a usable effect that can be registered to shortcuts with certain equipment only. The attack properties of magic blade skills (physical/magical) will now undergo a swap.

・Element Slash
Stats revised and now it will activate with your weak element.

・Enchant Sword
Revamped the damage calculation formula and skill effects, and consequently removed the buff effect that depends on magic device as sub-weapon.

・Enchanted Spell
Changed to EX skill. The skills to activate and the conditions can now be set in advance.
Furthermore, activated magic skills will now provide bonus for equipping magic device.

・Enchanted Burst
Revamped the skill content.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:September 22nd at 7:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:September 25th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6d8e56d360dd1ca989008e115e2b28c69e12f015.png
Furthermore, you can tame the special monsters inhabiting the beach as pets and go on adventures with them!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:August 25th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:August 28th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:July 28th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:July 31st at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/bb3b67635ee889ec2c330589304a8c5c229b32df.png
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members! 
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Let's Get "Summer Shell" from water element monsters!

Take note of the monster's element and hunt them during the event period!

*Summer Shell III can only be obtained through Challenge Dungeon (Lv300 or more).

Gigantic Octopus Invasion!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8508db8219d6fd049a1cc4cebe33a283452f3771.png
"Gigantic Octopus Invasion", the RAID battle that can be challenged by up to 8 players at the same time is currently available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c6c618a173616aaea7bf76d0646d86876eed2a4b.png
You can challenge it from the wormhole in "Saltau's Beach"!

A second party can enter the battle after the first party enters the battle field.
Please note that the second party has to enter within a certain period of time after the battle begins, and there has to be a certain amount of boss monster's HP remaining for the second party to be able to join.

Defeat the "Gigantic Octopus" to get new equipment that is perfect for this hot summer and "Big Takoyaki" which is a buff item to enhance your stats!

Enjoy the hot RAID battle with your friends and guild mates!

Notes
*The matching for RAID Battle can be enabled/disabled.
*When another party is joining the battle, the party members' HP will show up as a whole on the left side of the screen as "Secondary Party".
*The result rewards such as Attacker and Breaker will be defined in each party.
*Skills that affect party members such as the Support Skill "High Cycle" and Shield Skill "Guardian" will only affect the members in your party during the RAID Battle.
However, skills that can be used on a selected player such as the Support Skill "Heal" and "Recovery" can also be used on the player that is in another party.


Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!

Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/51cf7aabb3a8d8a6d69c947b947ce5ae21a0785d.png

Furthermore, you can tame the special monsters inhabiting the beach as pets and go on adventures with them!

They are valuable monsters that you can only find here, so make sure you take the challenge!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Notes
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.
