notes.title: PvP Battle Mode "Arena" Released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/362b6789d24963917c912c0f314b0ee4519b41a7.png
The PvP battle mode "Arena" has been officially released on Thursday, 7/20/2023.
It is available for play on all platforms. Besides, 4v4 mode and weekly emblems have also been added.

Basic Controls 
[table][tr][th]Actions[/th][th]Keys[/th][/tr][tr][td]Move forward[/td][td]"W" or "↑"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Move left[/td][td]"A" or "←"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Move backward[/td][td]"S" or "↓"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Move right[/td][td]"D" or  "→"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dash[/td][td]"L Shift"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rotate camera[/td][td]"Right Drag"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Interact(Action)[/td][td]"F"[/td][/tr][/table]

What's Arena?
Up to 32 players will gather on a special map for Arena to grow their abilities by beating monsters and searching for treasure chests.
The last player standing (alive) in the final area wins the game. If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the center of the map will be the winner.

How to Access Arena?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7519afcdc871705c374c6074348af1c663a0a924.png
You can go to Arena from a Save Point (town) from [ [Menu > Terminal > To Arena ].
To return to Save Point, go to [Menu > Terminal > Back to Town.]

How to Play Arena?
Game Flow
[table][tr][th]Phase 1[/th][td]For 5 minutes, kill monsters, find treasure chests, and defeat boss monsters to raise your level.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 2[/th][td]For 2 minutes, a damage area heading towards the central area will be formed in the outer perimeter area. Try not to get hit and move to the central area. [/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 3[/th][td]When the entire field except the central area has turned into a damage area, phase 3 which is a battle to determine the winner that lasts for 3 minutes will begin. 
The last player alive in the final central area wins.
If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the central area will be the winner.

If the player gets knocked out, the damage dealt by the player to the crystal will be lost.
Deal as much damage as you can to the crystal or beat other players and stay alive to win!
Think and choose your strategy wisely![/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Profile Registration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/64fd66c421f12e21926e178808c75ecdda0c8415.png
You need to register your PvP battle profile to play Arena.
You can register through the NPC "Megiston" on the Arena map.

PvP Battle Profile Registration Conditions
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]The level of the character that is registered must be Lv150 or higher.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Completed the story mission of Chapter 7 "Chaotic Truth".  
(the character with the most story progress in your account is used as a reference)[/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Settings
[table][tr][th]Your Fighter's Name[/th][td]Register a name to be used in Arena. Other players may use the same name.

*Your account may be restricted if an inappropriate name is used.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Your Element[/th][td]Choose 1 element that you like from the 7 available elements including Neutral.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Tendency of Proration[/th][td]Set your proration.
Use the points given to set your proration value as you like.

*The value of each proration cannot be 0.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Battle Abilities[/th][td]You can register up to 3 abilities that can only be used in Arena.[/td][/tr][/table]

Matching
Once you complete your PvP battle profile registration, you can proceed to matching as long as you are on the Arena map.

Select the battle rules displayed on the upper part of the screen and start matching.

Weekly Emblems!
Fulfill the conditions to get rewards every week!
Weekly Emblems with rewards that can be obtained by fulfilling certain conditions in the PvP battle mode "Arena" are available.
Make sure to play Arena and get awesome rewards!

[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Rewards[/th][/tr][tr][td]The Final Survivor[/td][td]Got 1st place in Casual Battle.[/td][td]Revive Droplet x3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Survivor[/td][td]Got into the Top 3 in Casual Battle.[/td][td]Revive Droplet x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Challenger[/td][td]Survived 10 times until Phase 3 in Casual Battle.[/td][td]Teleport Ticket x10[/td][/tr][tr][td]PvP Boss Hunter![/td][td]Defeated boss monster 3 times in Casual Battle.[/td][td]Teleport Ticket x10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Strong PvP Player[/td][td]Won 3 times in 1v1 mode or challenged it 30 times.[/td][td]Fairy Sewing Tool x3[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Power of Unity[/td][td]Won 3 times in 4v4 mode or challenged it 30 times.[/td][td]Fairy Sewing Tool x3[/td][/tr][/table]

Please note that even if you have fulfilled the conditions, the emblems will be reset at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on Sunday every week, so don't forget to claim the rewards.


*You can claim and receive emblems after clearing the conditions from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem].

Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills and Abilities
Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills
・Skills not available on PvP battle mode
　Wizard Skill "Familia"

・Skill Effects That Change on PvP battle mode
　Knight Skill "Provoke"
　The effect has been changed so that it will forcefully make you the target.

Restrictions of Abilities
・The effect of the ability granted to an avatar will not work on PvP Battle mode.
・Food and item buff effects will not work on PvP Battle mode.
・The maximum action speed on PvP Battle mode is 100%.

*Only the combo effect "Swift" or certain skills that speed up action can break this limit.

Notes
*Playable period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Let's Use Guild Recruitment Board to Join a Guild and Recruit Guild Members!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png
Guild Recruitment Board is a feature in the game to recruit guild members or find and join a guild that is looking for members.

You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search for guilds that are looking for members.

You can use the Guild Recruitment Board feature from the Guild Staff to recruit guild members.

*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.


Search for a Guild That Is Looking for Members and Join the Guild!
If you are currently not in a guild, you can search for a guild that is looking for members and join it from the Guild Recruitment Board.
You need to be at least Lv40 and you must have completed Story Mission Chapter 1 to search and join a guild that is looking for members. 

Finding a Guild That Is Looking for Members
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/ee7f5ada9b43234f5f1e7a51ef37b06797da8b64.png
You can do it from Menu > Community > Guild > Join Guild.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e1268a904384f2e4d86b4ccf393d445ba216fe04.png
When searching for a guild, you can enter the name and requirements set by the guild.

[table][tr][th]Membership Approval[/th][td]Not Specified / Auto / Manual[/td][/tr][tr][th]Requirements[/th][td]Not Specified / Max Level / Play Time / Story Progress[/td][/tr][tr][th]Search Guild Name[/th][td]You can enter the name of the guild you want to find.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Search Guild Master Name[/th][td]You can enter the name of the guild master of the guild you want to find.[/td][/tr][/table]



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/85a555cb2fabdd333cd5ff82a0c3b36cfd00bd38.png
Select "Search Guild" and the guild that matches the requirements or name you enter will be shown.  

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/827d5dacccf21d5290f048945b7daf231f24e37e.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/912f671143d9c9ade5f724cb8257f382567621e5.png[/td][/tr][/table]
If there is a guild you would like to join, you can do so from Join Request > Send Join Request .

*If the guild's membership approval is set to "Manual", you need to wait until your request is approved to join it. You can also cancel your join request if it has not been approved. 

Using Guild Recruitment Board to Recruit Guild Members
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/da9ad82b86a6f0ee5ff9531baf35e8bc542c0380.png
If your guild is eligible to use the Guild Recruitment Board, you can use the feature by talking to the Guild Staff. Go to Guild Menu > Guild Recruitment Board.

*Guild Staff is available when your guild reaches Lv15.
*Only the Guild Master and the Vice Master can edit the Guild Recruitment Board.


Set Your Guild's Requirements on the Guild Recruitment Board!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9835b06366e579ad6676390871191e854065ab81.png
You need to set the requirements below to start the recruitment of guild members on the Guild Recruitment Board.

Membership Approval
[table][tr][th]Auto[/th][td]Approve join requests automatically.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Manual[/th][td]Approve or reject join requests manually.[/td][/tr][/table]

Requirements
[table][tr][th]Max Level[/th][td]There level can be set from level 40.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Play Time[/th][td]The time can be set from 1 hour.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Story Progress[/th][td]The progress can be set from Chapter 2 Episode 10.[/td][/tr][/table]

Comment
You can set the comment to be displayed on the guild search screen.


Approving a Guild Join Request
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6f9892147ec9b9422a282e2787378c990e9ce57e.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b9d3e94c7bad34117793a53d2d15277e7ff637f5.png[/td][/tr][/table]
If it is set to manual, you can check the join requests from Menu > News > You've received a join request! after you start recruiting. You can also check them from Community > Guild > See Guild Requests.

The Guild Master and Vice Master will receive a notification when the guild receives a join request.The players can also view the join request through this notification.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/5c89a217d5dd6dc4af47af51b6d315ee52c3101c.png
Select approve to allow the player to join your guild or select ☓ to reject.

If you would like to end the guild members recruitment on the Guild Recruitment Board, you can talk to the Guild Staff and select Guild Menu > Guild Recruitment Board > End Recruitment.

*The join requests that have been sent for your guild will remain even after you end the recruitment. 

*The recruitment on the Guild Recruitment Board will end automatically for the following conditions.
・The guild becomes full.
・The maximum number of applicants has been reached. (100)

notes.title: [EDIT]Early Access to Play "Arena" Again!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f137d775ff20379834e0e90b3f7fa7ce68714d00.png
Get early access to play the competitive PvP battle mode "Arena" again starting from Thursday, 6/15/2023 (JST)! 
We have added the new "1v1 Mode" and "4v4 Mode" for the 3rd early access to play Arena.

[EDIT:6/16 17:00 PM(JST)]
"4v4 Mode" is currently not available for play.
"Casual Battle" and "1v1 Mode" are available for play.

*"Arena" will be playable first on the Steam and Windows version.
*You need to meet the registration conditions for the PvP battle profile to play "Arena".
　See the "Profile Registration Conditions" below for details.


Playable Period
From:6/15/2023 after the maintenance
Until:7/13/2023 before the maintenance

*Playable period is subject to change and adjustments.

What's Arena?
Up to 32 players will gather on a special map for Arena to grow their abilities by beating monsters and searching for treasure chests.
The last player standing (alive) in the final area wins the game. If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the center of the map will be the winner.

How to Access Arena?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7519afcdc871705c374c6074348af1c663a0a924.png
You can move to the venue of Arena from[ Menu > Terminal > To Arena ].
To return to Save Point, go to[ Menu > Terminal > Back to Town ].

How to Play Arena?
Game Flow
[table][tr][th]Phase 1[/th][td]For 5 minutes, kill monsters, find treasure chests, and defeat boss monsters to raise your level.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 2[/th][td]For 2 minutes, a damage area heading towards the central area will be formed in the outer perimeter area. Try not to get hit and move to the central area. [/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 3[/th][td]When the entire field except the central area has turned into a damage area, phase 3 which is a battle to determine the winner that lasts for 3 minutes will begin. 
The last player alive in the final central area wins.
If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the central area will be the winner.

If the player gets knocked out, the damage dealt by the player to the crystal will be lost.
Deal as much damage as you can to the crystal or beat other players and stay alive to win!
Think and choose your strategy wisely![/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Profile Registration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/64fd66c421f12e21926e178808c75ecdda0c8415.png
You need to register your PvP battle profile to play Arena.
You can register through the NPC "Megiston" on the Arena map.

PvP Battle Profile Registration Conditions
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]The level of the character that is registered must be Lv150 or higher.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Completed the story mission of Chapter 7 "Chaotic Truth".  
(the character with the most story progress in your account is used as a reference)[/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Settings
[table][tr][th]Your Fighter's Name[/th][td]Register a name to be used in Arena. Other players may use the same name.
*Your account may be restricted if an inappropriate name is used.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Your Element[/th][td]Choose 1 element that you like from the 7 available elements including Neutral.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Tendency of Proration[/th][td]Set your proration.
Use the points given to set your proration value as you like.
*The value of each proration cannot be 0.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Battle Abilities[/th][td]You can register up to 3 abilities that can only be used in Arena.[/td][/tr][/table]

Matching
Once you complete your PvP battle profile registration, you can proceed to matching as long as you are on the Arena map.

Select the battle rules displayed on the upper part of the screen and start matching.

Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills and Abilities
Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills
・Skills not available on PvP battle mode
　Wizard Skill "Familia"

・Skill Effects That Change on PvP battle mode
　Knight Skill "Provoke"
　The effect has been changed so that it will forcefully make you the target.

Restrictions of Abilities

 The effect of the ability granted to an avatar will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 Food and item buff effects will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 The maximum action speed on PvP Battle mode is 100%.


*Only the combo effect "Swift" or certain skills that speed up action can break this limit.

Notes
*Playable period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

The "June Bride" event allows you to join forces and trade with your close friends or guild members, thus improving interaction and helping you to build and develop your character.

June Bride Event Period
From: 06/08/2023 after the maintenance
Until: 06/29/2023 before maintenance

What's June Bride Event?
Players will be granted the event bonus below if there are 2 or more characters in the party regardless of gender.

Form a party to earn more EXP!
"EXP Gain +20%" bonus buff.

*The bonus from this campaign is not applicable to pets.
*The boost effect from this event will be stacked with the effect from Orb items and 30-Day Tickets.

Get Limited Treasure Box!
Furthermore, depending on the gender of the player's character, the player can get June Bride Event-limited Treasure Box when the boss is defeated.

A male/neutral A character will get the "Groom Box" and a female/neutral B character will get the "Bride Box".
The contents of the treasure boxes for male characters and those for female characters are different and various items can be obtained randomly.

Of all the items you can get, the "June Bride Limited Equipment" has the perfect design that is suitable for the groom and the bride for their wedding.

*The increased "Selling Price" and "Material Points" as well as the creator name of "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will be attached only if they are traded with another player or sent as a gift.

3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:May 26th at 7:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:May 29th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/d494deef65d8e9c21ee823298d2cdc42662dcd9c.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

Along with skill balance adjustments, skill & stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 5/25/2023 after the maintenance
Until: 6/1/2023 5:00 AM(JST/GMT+9)

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 5/25/2023 before the maintenance) x1
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 10 times in total.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"]
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fffa507dc45916c00b22335280f5a62f523936f.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/beed805ee680a96d177cb4c95c2d852f523aa2fa.png[/td][/tr][/table]

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap ["Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/eecfea4b5a5599b330a0b7da9e108be50057f1a3.png
For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Early Access to Play "Arena" Again!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f137d775ff20379834e0e90b3f7fa7ce68714d00.png
Get early access to play the competitive PvP battle mode "Arena" again starting from Thursday, 5/18/2023 (JST)! 

*"Arena" will be playable first on the Steam and Windows version.
*You need to meet the registration conditions for the PvP battle profile to play "Arena".
　See the "Profile Registration Conditions" below for details.


Playable Period
From: 5/18/2023 after the maintenance
Until: 5/31/2023 before the maintenance

*Playable period is subject to change and adjustments.

What's Arena?
Up to 32 players will gather on a special map for Arena to grow their abilities by beating monsters and searching for treasure chests.
The last player standing (alive) in the final area wins the game. If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the center of the map will be the winner.

How to Access Arena?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7519afcdc871705c374c6074348af1c663a0a924.png
You can move to the venue of Arena from[ Menu > Terminal > To Arena ].
To return to Save Point, go to[ Menu > Terminal > Back to Town ].

How to Play Arena?
Game Flow
[table][tr][th]Phase 1[/th][td]For 5 minutes, kill monsters, find treasure chests, and defeat boss monsters to raise your level.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 2[/th][td]For 2 minutes, a damage area heading towards the central area will be formed in the outer perimeter area. Try not to get hit and move to the central area. [/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 3[/th][td]When the entire field except the central area has turned into a damage area, phase 3 which is a battle to determine the winner that lasts for 3 minutes will begin. 
The last player alive in the final central area wins.
If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the central area will be the winner.

If the player gets knocked out, the damage dealt by the player to the crystal will be lost.
Deal as much damage as you can to the crystal or beat other players and stay alive to win!
Think and choose your strategy wisely![/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Profile Registration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/64fd66c421f12e21926e178808c75ecdda0c8415.png
You need to register your PvP battle profile to play Arena.
You can register through the NPC "Megiston" on the Arena map.

PvP Battle Profile Registration Conditions
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]The level of the character that is registered must be Lv150 or higher.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Completed the story mission of Chapter 7 "Chaotic Truth".  
(the character with the most story progress in your account is used as a reference)[/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Settings
[table][tr][th]Your Fighter's Name[/th][td]Register a name to be used in Arena. Other players may use the same name.
*Your account may be restricted if an inappropriate name is used.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Your Element[/th][td]Choose 1 element that you like from the 7 available elements including Neutral.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Tendency of Proration[/th][td]Set your proration.
Use the points given to set your proration value as you like.
*The value of each proration cannot be 0.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Battle Abilities[/th][td]You can register up to 3 abilities that can only be used in Arena.[/td][/tr][/table]

Matching
Once you complete your PvP battle profile registration, you can proceed to matching as long as you are on the Arena map.

Select the battle rules displayed on the upper part of the screen and start matching.

Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills and Abilities
Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills
・Skills not available on PvP battle mode
　Wizard Skill "Familia"

・Skill Effects That Change on PvP battle mode
　Knight Skill "Provoke"
　The effect has been changed so that it will forcefully make you the target.

Restrictions of Abilities

 The effect of the ability granted to an avatar will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 Food and item buff effects will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 The maximum action speed on PvP Battle mode is 100%.


*Only the combo effect "Swift" or certain skills that speed up action can break this limit.

Notes
*Playable period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: Be the First to Play "Arena"!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e4ea3129696ddc669617ef9a3b752b4f561421fb.png
"Arena", a PvP battle mode where players can compete with one another will be playable on 4/17/2023.

*"Arena" will be playable first on the Steam and Windows version.
*You need to meet the registration conditions for the PvP battle profile to play "Arena".
　See the "Profile Registration Conditions" below for details.


Playable Period
Weekdays (Mon-Fri) 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)
End Date & Time: 4/21/2023 7:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

*Playable period is subject to change and adjustments.

What's Arena?
Up to 32 players will gather on a special map for Arena to grow their abilities by beating monsters and searching for treasure chests.
The last player standing (alive) in the final area wins the game. If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the center of the map will be the winner.

How to Access Arena?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/e4ea3129696ddc669617ef9a3b752b4f561421fb.png
You can move to the venue of Arena from[ Menu > Terminal > To Arena ].
To return to Save Point, go to[ Menu > Terminal > Back to Town ].

How to Play Arena?
Game Flow
[table][tr][th]Phase 1[/th][td]For 5 minutes, kill monsters, find treasure chests, and defeat boss monsters to raise your level.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 2[/th][td]For 2 minutes, a damage area heading towards the central area will be formed in the outer perimeter area. Try not to get hit and move to the central area. [/td][/tr][tr][th]Phase 3[/th][td]When the entire field except the central area has turned into a damage area, phase 3 which is a battle to determine the winner that lasts for 3 minutes will begin. 
The last player alive in the final central area wins.
If the time is up and there is more than 1 player alive, the player who deals the most damage to the crystal appearing in the central area will be the winner.

If the player gets knocked out, the damage dealt by the player to the crystal will be lost.
Deal as much damage as you can to the crystal or beat other players and stay alive to win!
Think and choose your strategy wisely![/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Profile Registration
You need to register your PvP battle profile to play Arena.
You can register through the NPC "Megiston" on the Arena map.

PvP Battle Profile Registration Conditions
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]The level of the character that is registered must be Lv150 or higher.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]Completed the story mission of Chapter 7 "Chaotic Truth".  
(the character with the most story progress in your account is used as a reference)[/td][/tr][/table]

PvP Battle Settings
[table][tr][th]Your Fighter's Name[/th][td]Register a name to be used in Arena. Other players may use the same name.
*Your account may be restricted if an inappropriate name is used.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Your Element[/th][td]Choose 1 element that you like from the 7 available elements including Neutral.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Tendency of Proration[/th][td]Set your proration.
Use the points given to set your proration value as you like.
*The value of each proration cannot be 0.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Battle Abilities[/th][td]You can register up to 3 abilities that can only be used in Arena.[/td][/tr][/table]

Matching
Once you complete your PvP battle profile registration, you can proceed to matching as long as you are on the Arena map.

Select the battle rules displayed on the upper part of the screen and start matching.

Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills and Abilities
Changes of Skill Effects and Restrictions of Skills
・Skills not available on PvP battle mode
　Wizard Skill "Familia"

・Skill Effects That Change on PvP battle mode
　Knight Skill "Provoke"
　The effect has been changed so that it will forcefully make you the target.

Restrictions of Abilities

 The effect of the ability granted to an avatar will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 The skill obtained from a Star Gem cannot be used on PvP Battle mode.
 Food and item buff effects will not work on PvP Battle mode.
 The maximum action speed on PvP Battle mode is 100%.


*Only the combo effect "Swift" or certain skills that speed up action can break this limit.

Notes
*Playable period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:March 24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:March 27th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Cookie" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Blue Wrapping Ribbon"!

Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

notes.title: Address System on Your Land Introduced!
notes.content:
Let's Set the Address of Your Land!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7559eed6a9485d41f88a5a208b5dd59ecb88af85.png
With this system, you get to assign the address of your own land and other players can visit it by entering the address.
After purchasing the land for Your Land and expanding it to 40 squares, you will be able to set your address from Menu > House Management > Toram Address.

Let's Set Your Address!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2fde08e88807e6ea5c54c8eaf439599aed0f59b7.png
Your Land's address is comprised of 3 sections, namely Region, Ward, and Number.
Feel free to choose any combination of the 3 sections above to your liking when registering your address. 

Below are the details about each section.

1. Region
[table][tr][th]Region[/th][th]Condition to Unlock[/th][/tr][tr][td]Sofya[/td][td]Selectable from the beginning[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rugio[/td][td]Selectable from the beginning[/td][/tr][tr][td]El Scaro[/td][td]Selectable from the beginning[/td][/tr][tr][td]Einklang[/td][td]Cleared Chapter 6 
"Mystery of the Black Knights"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Lyark[/td][td]Cleared Chapter 7 
"Chaotic Truth"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Nov Saterica[/td][td]Cleared Chapter 8 
"At Mountains' End"[/td][/tr][tr][td]Erva Tronc[/td][td]Cleared Chapter 11 
"The Weredragons & the Underground World"[/td][/tr][/table]
*The choice of region will be added in the future as the story progresses.
*The region that can be selected is based on the character with the most story mission progress on your account.
*Regions other than the above may be selectable during special events.

2. Ward
You may choose any alphabet from A to Z.

3. Number
You may choose any number from 0 to 9999.

*Change Your Land to public mode to set your address.
*The address with the combination of Region+Ward+Number that is exactly the same as an existing address cannot be registered again.

What's Easy Register?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/9bc068148d5fdc01af8f0ea0c00d2ee141006371.png
It's a feature to automatically create an address that is available on the selected map.
Make use of this feature to save the hassle of thinking about an address.

Deleting Your Address
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7364b3b89aa62765d7725bcf992b28b66f2c094a.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/4b8c29d9191fe3d99a98ec3a651998101ad9b757.png[/td][/tr][/table]

Delete your address so that other players cannot search for Your Land.
To delete your current address, go to Menu > House Management > Toram Address > Delete Address.

*After you have deleted your address, you need to wait for 72 hours before you can register a new address.
*You can register a new address without waiting if you have an active 30-Day Ticket.


Let's Get Your Friend's Address and Visit Their Land! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c4d50c9afd2d5b3191cce8174ead909931ff377.png
You can visit other player's land by searching their address.
Enter the address or the Simple Code to move to the land you would like to visit.

Tap Terminal > Go to Your Land/Leave Land > Visit Another Player's Land > Search and you will be taken to the address or Simple Code input page.

*Please note that you will be unable to select "Set Off" if the same address is entered consecutively.

Let's Make Use of Simple Code!
Register your address to get the Simple Code and you can share this convenient code with your friends.
You can also move to the land you would like to visit by entering the Simple Code, so make use of it!

The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note

*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

notes.title: Limited Event: "Snowball Fight" Released! Hit Snowballs!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/afa309bbc2685ba6a076219765310c3b38f441d3.png
Now you can play "Snowball Fight" in the world of Toram Online for a limited period of time after the maintenance 2/16/2023!
 Use and exchange the "Snowball Points" you get from "Snowball Fight" for rare items that are exclusive to this event!

Make sure to play it with your jolly good friends or guild members and enjoy the exciting game!

"Snowball Fight" Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/16/2023
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/13/2023

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

What is Snowball Fight?
Players are divided into 2 teams and compete the number of snowballs they hit within 3 minutes.

Tips for Snowball Fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c5530aeeb580a16e671864951646ea2a30e586b4.png
You can access the mini-game venue from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Go to snowball fight venue" at Save Point.

Also, you can go to Save Point from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Back to Town" from the mini-game venue.

Overview
[table][tr][th]1[/th][td]Tap "I'm ready!!" after moving to the snowball fight field.[/td][/tr][tr][th]2[/th][td]The game will start with selected players via auto-matching.[/td][/tr][tr][th]3[/th][td]The winner is the team that holds more HP than the other.
Snowball Points will increase a little and you will get 1 Ice & Snow Bucket if you win.
[/td][/tr][/table]
*You cannot get the item if your bag is full.
*"Snow Bear Box" that you can get from Prize Exchange has a low chance to appear too from "Ice & Snow Bucket".

Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/76f45b1a60e3e3ec8f76b67b7c2722579431dba1.png
[table][tr][th]HP[/th][td]It decreases if you are hit by opponents.
Blue HP shows allied team's HP, red shows opponent team's HP.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Make[/th][td]You can sit down and create snowballs.
The more you hold snowballs, the longer it takes to create a snowball.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Throw[/th][td]You can throw a snowball.
Snowballs are thrown toward the "+" mark in front of the screen.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Auto[/th][td]You can throw a snowball to a player within the range and sight.[/td][/tr][tr][th]Dodge[/th][td]You can dodge snowballs by quickly moving a short distance.
If you are holding snowballs, you may lose them.[/td][/tr][/table]
* All throwing motions will become slower if you are in the enemy's zone.

Snowball Fight gets more exciting with items!!
Treasure Boxes Appear on the Snowball Fight Field!!
You can get a "30-second Buff Item" by tapping the treasure box that appears on the Snowball Fight field!

[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Buff[/th][/tr][tr][td]Ice Meteor[/td][td]Ice chunks fall if you place a snowball on the ground![/td][/tr][tr][td]Ice Barrier[/td][td]No frostbite for up to 3 hits![/td][/tr][tr][td]Team Rescue[/td][td]Fully recover from frostbite.Team HP restored![/td][/tr][tr][td]Jumbo Ball[/td][td]Snowballs become bigger![/td][/tr][tr][td]Triple[/td][td]Snowballs thrown become 3![/td][/tr][/table]
Also, you can steal the buff from knocking down a buffed player!

Have fun using the items and use of them well to lead your team to victory!!

About Frostbite and Respawn
If you get hit by a snowball, you will flinch and get frostbite that causes the screen to freeze for a little bit. If you get another hit in this condition, you will tumble and the screen will continue to freeze. Furthermore, if you get a third hit, you will freeze to death. After the death animation is shown, you will be taken back to the starting point and you lose 200 HP.

You will heal or return to the previous stage of frostbite if you don't get hit for 12 seconds. 
You will be invincible for a few seconds when you flinch or tumble.

Snowball Fight Limited Special Daily Emblems Available!
Emblems that give you Ticket Pieces and other items will be available during the event period below.

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems
[table][tr][th]Emblem[/th][th]Condition[/th][th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (Participate)[/td][td]Play Snowball Fight 2 times
Join from Terminal[/td][td]Revive Droplet x1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Daily Bonus (1st Victory)[/td][td]Win Snowball Fight once.[/td][td]Ticket Piece x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]Snowball Fight Ticket Bonus[/td][td]Obtain a 30-Day Ticket.[/td][td]Ice & Snow Bucket x2[/td][/tr][/table]
Win the snowball fight and get gorgeous items every day!

Snowball Fight Daily Emblems Available Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/16/2023
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/13/2023

Please note that the emblems are reset at 5:00 AM (JST/ GMT+9) every day, so please don't forget to claim and receive the rewards once you have cleared the condition.

*Emblems can be received when the conditions are met from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem. ].

Notes
*The battle begins after all the party members tap "I'm ready!!".
*The snowballs made during the previous match cannot be used.
*If matchmaking fails within the time limit after tapping "I'm ready!!", you will return to waiting mode to tap "I'm ready!!" again.
*Ranking based on the number of snowball you threw does not affect your win or loss.
*You will not be able to tap a new treasure box to get an additional buff when you still have a buff that is active.
*If you knock down a buffed player from the opponent's team while having an active buff, the buff stolen from the player will be granted to one of your team members.
However, if all players in your team already have a buff that is active, the stolen buff will disappear.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Let's Collect "Red Wrapping Ribbons"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/091891d5f6637d30f348867b337c8187c4bc5269.png
During the event period, you can create "Heart Chocolate" by collecting the "Red Wrapping Ribbons" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Chocolate" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Chocolate" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Chocolate"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/7cf3e9411b02982cf87bd72663422e56ffb4e436.png
If you trade "Heart Chocolate" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its HP healing effect will greatly increase.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for Valentine's Day.

Give it directly to the one and only important person of yours with love!

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
   Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/d494deef65d8e9c21ee823298d2cdc42662dcd9c.png
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

In order to celebrate the comeback of the collab event, skill & stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 1/26/2023 after the maintenance
Until: 2/9/2023 before the maintenance

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 1/26/2023 before the maintenance) x 1
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 10 times in total.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here![/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"[/td][/tr][/table]
Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

notes.title: Staff, Magic Device, and Skill Adjustments
notes.content:
Staff, magic device and a few skills have been adjusted during the maintenance on Thursday, 12/15/2022.
Below are the details of the adjustments.

Adjustments to Staff

 Removed damage increase based on INT value when dealing elemental magic damage the target is weak to.
 Damage will be increased according to INT value when dealing magic damage of all elements except neutral magic.
 Added the chance for critical when dealing neutral magic damage.



Adjustments to Magic Device

 Removed damage increase based on INT value when dealing elemental magic damage the target is weak to.
 Damage will be increased according to INT value when dealing magic damage of all elements except neutral magic.



Chain Cast

 In addition to the current skill effect, you will now get 1 magic buff each time a skill attack that requires casting hits. (max 10 buffs can be obtained) 
Buff details: Shorter casting time, increase in magic stability and MATK



Shell Break

 Increased the chance of [Armor Break] by 25% when your main equipment is knuckles.



Strong Chase Attack

 Removed the effect where there is a low chance of "Armor Break" due to the damage dealt with the skill "Aggravate".
 In exchange for that, a passive effect that increases accuracy has been added.
 Moreover, accuracy is further increased and the skill "Aggravate" will ignore defense power to a certain level when your main equipment is knuckles.

Event Period

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6b95fde7426291d5af17af9a2e40e540b2e3fe01.png
The Xmas Event held up to 2021 has been reinstated through the maintenance on 11/24/2022.

Bringing you lots of fun including limited-edition quests and recipes, as well as events where gifts are delivered daily to your Xmas Stockings by Santa Claus!

Meanwhile, the new content of Xmas Event for 2022 will be added through the maintenance at a later date.

Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 11/24/2022
Until: Before the maintenance on 12/27/2022

*Some events and promotions end on different dates.
Please check each official announcement for the details.

Limited map "Navida's Relics" Is Opened & Recipes Are Brought Back!
[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f918aa94958e5f3a33935b5b3d53ac42b82925a7.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d038554535f6c3cbbe3d7343e11131b546ad12c.png[/td][/tr][/table]
The event maps that appeared in the previous Xmas Event will reappear.

Navida's Relics can be accessed from the wormhole at "Sofya City", "El Scaro", "Hora Diomedea","Draco Town" and "Polde Ice Valley" during the event period.
Also, the wormhole to "Frozen Navida City" is at "Navida's Relics".

We hope you can enjoy the Xmas Event to the fullest at the limited-edition Xmas-themed maps!

*You can access Polde Ice Valley from Navida's Relics by completing the Xmas quests.

*"Polde Ice Valley" and "Fort Solfini" are not event-limited maps.
You can freely explore the maps event after the event ends.

*The content of "Fort Solfini" after the Xmas Event ends will be the same as that in "Difficulty: Lv70-90".

Xmas Limited Quests Released!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/0580f12acac53033192e4169ce749dd8d7f7c6f7.png
You can play the special stories with the members of the caravan and the Xmas knights that bring back nostalgia at the special map "Navida's Relics".
Enjoy your adventure with them in a map full of Xmas sensation!

*The quests will be unlocked one after another by clearing the quests unlocked after completing "The Unknown Place and Offerings".

*The status of the quests will stay as "CLEARED" if you had cleared them before during the Xmas Event held in the previous years. 

*During the selection of difficulty level in certain quests, you will move to a different map if you select a different difficulty from that of your party members.
 Please confirm the difficulty you choose before the challenge when playing in a party.

Special Gift Event! Let's Hang Xmas Stockings on the Trees!
What's "Xmas Star"?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b42d48f4941c2b3bb118e4e0002bbe3422e2be16.png
It's an item that has a certain chance of being dropped by some monsters during the Xmas Event.

"Xmas Star" can be exchanged for "Xmas Stocking" at "Navida's Relics".

Let's Hang Xmas Stockings on the Trees!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2f77f74654874c07022ed16d8a1334c0cbcc807d.png
You can hang up to 5 "Xmas Stockings",which you can get from the Xmas quests, on the 2 fir trees in Navida's Relics.
If you hang a stocking by 4:59 AM (JST/GMT+9), you will find a gift in it at 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9).

[strike]*Please check the announcement that will be published separately on 12/8 for details about the count of Xmas Stockings hung to receive gifts.[/strike]

Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/5b6e1429a031dd48384f447825ce481800869756.png
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/a25e6ccd83b8aa73b8930e2562fefba820c8b237.png

"Slayers" x "Toram Online" Collaboration Event will be held from 11/17/2022 after the maintenance!

This collab event features avatars that can transform you into the characters that appear in "Slayers" as well as weapons and skill modeled after the equipment and magic used by the characters.

Let's put on the equipment that appears in "Slayers" and embark on a journey into the adventurous world of Toram!

[table][tr][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/065582de5b01a640dfa8afd0a807cf5449146a68.png[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/4401dd06ade9a9ead61f1cd687579aeeaa952f92.png[/td][/tr][/table]

There you can get weapons modeled after the weapon and magic used by the characters in "Slayers" such as "Sword of Light" and "Visphalanx"!

Collect "Slayers Ticket" from Slayers Collab Emblems and exchange them for various gorgeous weapons and useful item!

From: 11/17/2022 after maintenance

"Slayers" Collab Avatar Chest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/2d17e26d544d0a1815dcbc175aa822a930e98c7f.png
Special Collab Avatar Chest containing costumes that can transform you into the characters that appear in "Slayers" is available!
Furthermore, Lina＝Inverse's costume is a special costume as you will be able to use the skill "Dragslave" if you wear one of it.

Don't miss the special avatars that can only be obtained during this collab!


Available for Purchase
From: 11/17/2022 after maintenance
Until: 12/8/2022 before maintenance


Special Skill Available!
Crush Enemies with "Dragslave"!
The black magic "Dragslave" used by the character that appears in "Slayers", "Lina＝Inverse", is recreated in Toram!
After wearing one of Lina＝Inverse's avatars, the skill can be used by setting it on shortcut. 
Furthermore, the power of "Dragslave" will be greatly increased during the collab period!!

Avatars with the Skill

 Lina's Garb (T)
 Lina's Garb (B)
 Lina's Cape
 Lina's Hairstyle
 Lina's Face


Dragslave
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/830515a21c8eeee29e61d4f8fbb2f9e580a28c63.png
Deals neutral damage to target. Stronger with higher MP Cost and MaxMP, inflicts [Weaken] and [Armor Break] to all targets hit.

*In order to set an avatar skill on shortcut, you are required to equip one of the items that enable you to use the avatar skill on "Avatar Accessory".

*The avatar skills is not available for Combo.

*The avatar skill will be available even after the collaboration ends as long as you meet the required conditions.

*The damage boost effect of the "avatar skill" will no longer be available after the collab ends.


Collab-Limited Daily Bonuses!
Get Useful Rewards for Your Adventure Every Day!

Make sure to log in every day and get various daily bonuses!

Notes
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.


What's "Slayers"?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8a3018cddb6ca26122d22dafebe126bc2919200f.png
A world full of magic with evil things lurking in the dark - A young girl training to become a sorceress was traveling the world. Her name is Lina＝Inverse.
Despite her young appearance, she is a genius sorceress that would strike terror into the hearts of people, earning her the nickname Lina the "Dragon Spooker" (even a dragon would step out of her way).
Lina met Gourry, a master swordsman, by chance and together they set out on a journey to Atlas City.
They were followed by Zelgadis, an odd-looking sorcerer swordsman. Finding the demon lord, Shabranigdu, to restore his human form seems to be his goal.
What exactly are demon lords? What are they scheming?
Lina's finishing blow "Dragslave" is unleashed against such formidable enemies!



©Hajime Kanzaka, Rui Araizumi

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:October 28th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:October 31st at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Halloween Event Chapter 7 quest will be playable after completing Chapter 4 story mission "The King of Darkan" and Halloween Event Chapter 6.

Also after completing Chapter 7 once (you will see the word CLEARED), the quest will become playable too from the wormhole in Sofya City, Hora Diomedea, and Draco Town.

Let's enjoy the quest on new difficulty mode with your friends and guildmates!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/efb02758ff39d4c2a9edd3b36f18e47c38e6bd72.png
Furthermore, you can tame the special monsters inhabiting the beach as pets and go on adventures with them!

They are valuable monsters that you can only find here, so make sure you take the challenge!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

notes.title: Setting the "Auto-Discard" Feature
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/1b3f733b175fa9cb49e895e1ad53b4228b2d4182.png
We have added a bag feature that allows items to be automatically discarded.
You will be able to automatically discard the new item (equipment only) you get based on the condition you have set.

Auto-Discard Item Options
You can set the item to be discarded automatically from Menu > Settings > Auto-Item.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Condition[/th]
        [th]Options[/th]
        [th]Explanation[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]A No Slot[/td]
        [td]Keep/Discard[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the item based on the presence of slot.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]B Poor Ability[/td]
        [td]Keep/If it is +10% or less/If it is +20% or less/If it is +30% or less/If it is +40% or less/If it is +50% or less/If it is +60% or less/If it is +70% or less/If it is +80% or less/If it is +90% or less[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the item based on the value of its ability.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]C Duplicate[/td]
        [td]Keep/Discard from no.2/Discard from no.3/Discard from no.4[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the same item if you have already got a certain number of them.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
The item will automatically be discarded based on the condition you choose.

*Locked, Favorites, and Created Items are excluded from being auto-discarded.
*For 2-slot equipment and equipment with color info, all conditions will be ignored and the items will be obtained.
*All the conditions you have set will be ignored and items will be obtained when a Holy Gem that has the effect of raising item drop rate is in use.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:August 26th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:August 29th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Furthermore, you can tame the special monsters inhabiting the beach as pets and go on adventures with them!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

As compensation for the inconvenience caused by the bugs and game balance adjustments after the implementation of Lv5 skills, skill reset and stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Available Period
From: 07/14/2022 after the maintenance
Until: 07/21/2022 before the maintenance

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 07/14/2022 before the maintenance) x 1
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 10 times in total.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Exemption of Spinas Required to Learn a Skill
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6c611cebd45e89d4b31ff8ef9901ce4d0ac09057.png
The Library is Here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/90b19e833b60c72139bea06eedd29f063651e2a1.png
NPC "Lilulu"

Players will be exempted from paying Spinas to the NPC "Lilulu" in the Library in "Sofya City" when acquiring a skill.

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:June 24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:June 27th at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

*World Treasure is not a time-limited event or feature.

notes.title: It's June and It's Time for the June Bride Event!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/8997e192d409cd7a2b283ca2bc7cb707669867ea.png
The "June Bride" event allows you to join forces and trade with your close friends or guild members, thus improving interaction and helping you to build and develop your character

June Bride Event Period
From: 06/09/2022 after the maintenance
Until: 07/01/2022 5:00 AM (JST/GMT+9)

What's June Bride Event?
Players will be granted the event bonus below if there are 2 or more characters in the party regardless of gender.

Form a party to earn more EXP!
"EXP Gain +20%" bonus buff.

*The bonus from this campaign is not applicable to pets.
*The boost effect from this event will be stacked with the effect from Orb items and 30-Day Tickets.


Get Limited Treasure Box!

Furthermore, depending on the gender of the player's character, the player can get June Bride Event-limited Treasure Box when the boss is defeated.

A male/neutral A character will get the "Groom Box" and a female/neutral B character will get the "Bride Box".
The contents of the treasure boxes for male characters and those for female characters are different and various items can be obtained randomly.

Of all the items you can get, the "June Bride Limited Equipment" has the perfect design that is suitable for the groom and the bride for their wedding.

Let's Trade "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/008b8e10d90063a8b94f4a4f2082e0ab4491cf2c.png
If you trade ""Marriage Gift (Empty)" or "Toss Bouquet" with another adventurer or receive it as a gift during the June Bride Event, the item will become untradable and the "Selling Price" as well as the "Material Points" will greatly increase.

Why don't you take this opportunity and try trading them with your friends or guild members?

Notes

*Mercenaries, partners and pets are not counted as party members.
*Please note that "Groom Box" and "Bride Box" cannot be obtained from certain boss monsters.
*Only male characters can get the "Groom Box" and only female characters can get the "Bride Box".
*The "Groom Box" and the "Bride Box" will be removed through the maintenance held on 07/07/2022.
*The increased "Selling Price" and "Material Points" as well as the creator name of "Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will be attached only if they are traded with another player or sent as a gift.
"Marriage Gift (Empty)" and "Toss Bouquet" will remain the same even if they are sold on the Consignment Board.
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/f139611479f3428b5ed6c2bd296956fe90294764.png
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

Event Period
From:May 27th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

notes.title: New Bag Feature "Auto-Discard" Added!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/40b174e5d201e11da8ba6390a0043feac3323d40.png
We have added a bag feature that allows items to be automatically discarded.
You will be able to automatically discard the new item (equipment only) you get based on the condition you have set.

Setting the "Auto-Discard" Feature
You can set the item to be discarded automatically from Menu > Settings > Auto-Item.
The item will automatically be discarded based on the condition you choose.

Auto-Discard Item Options
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Condition[/th]
        [th]Options[/th]
        [th]Explanation[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]A No Slot[/td]
        [td]Keep・Discard[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the item based on the presence of slot.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]B Poor Ability[/td]
        [td]Keep・If it is +10% or less・If it is +20% or less・If it is +30% or less・If it is +40% or less・If it is +50% or less・If it is +60% or less・If it is +70% or less・If it is +80% or less・If it is +90% or less[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the item based on the value of its ability.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]C Duplicate[/td]
        [td]Keep・Discard from no.2・Discard from no.3・Discard from no.4[/td]
        [td]You can choose to auto-discard the same item if you have already got a certain number of them.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
*Locked, Favorites, and Created Items are excluded from being auto-discarded.
*For 2-slot equipment and equipment with color info, all conditions will be ignored and the items will be obtained.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset
notes.content:
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

As compensation for the inconvenience caused by the bugs and game balance adjustments after the implementation of Lv5 skills, skill reset and stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills during the period below.

Available Period
From: 04/7/2022 after the maintenance
Until: 04/14/2022 before the maintenance

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 4/7/2022 before the maintenance) x 2
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 20 times in total.

How to Reset

Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free". 

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.

*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.

*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.

*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.

*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.

*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.

*Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.

Maintenance Details

 Free Skill & Stats Reset will be held.
 Your Land's background will be changed.
 White Day Event will end.

The limited-edition recipes will be available until the maintenance on 4/14/2022 begins.

Skill Adjustments

 Separate the stat changes of Shut-Out when used with a One-Handed Sword for basic use and when dealing huge damage.
 Fix the issue where proration and Sword Technique are not reflected on the additional attack of Lunar Slash.
 Add the ability to reduce physical/magical damage while moving during Retrograde Shot.
 If the target of Parabola Cannon is marked, the projectile becomes more likely to hit the target.
 Remove the Mana Explosion that happens when Magic: Magic Cannon is overcharged because it was too difficult to manage.
 Increase AGI and remove the decrease in the power of long range attack when using Flash Blink with knuckles (main).
 Adjust Garyou Tensei so that Kairiki Ranshin will no longer auto-activate when the skill changes and the power is adjusted so that it is almost similar to the original (increase with Armor Break).
 Review (nerf) the ability of Draconic Charge as it has been poorly adjusted compared to the other skills.
 As the effect of Tornado Lance was different from the intended design, the increase in guaranteed hits will be adjusted so that it will be reflected after the Dazzled effect.


The following improvements have been applied.

 Added animation for Guild RAID's time limit.
 Added a voting feature to escape from Guild RAID.


The following issues have been fixed.

 Under certain conditions, the skill "Twin Storm" does not deal damage efficiently.
 Occasional abnormal display of Retrograde Shot's marker.
 The buff effect of "Tornado Lance" is granted to "One-Handed Sword".
 Minor bug fixes.
