Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Cookie" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Blue Wrapping Ribbon"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/3d097cb7377e06065637892d19ff4cdb9e329602.png
During the event period, you can create "Heart Cookie" by collecting the "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Cookie" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Cookie" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Cookie"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/6d8dc6ce99eaf53172e7f056738deed055ad166a.png
If you trade "Heart Cookie" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its MP healing effect will increase by 10 times.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for White Day.

How about giving them to your friends or guild members who always help you out?

Notes
*You cannot obtain "Blue Wrapping Ribbon" from special event maps such as Guild Maze or Challenge Dungeon.
*The creator's name of the "Heart Cookie" will be displayed only when it is traded during the event period.
"Heart Cookie"'s MP healing effect increases only when it is traded during the event period.
The aforementioned changes will not apply to the "Heart Cookie" when sent via gift or sold with the Consignment system.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!
Example of Monster That Can Be Captured
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c671faad3ed3277828b0dd35dd341d29f09667d0.png
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/95f6a0589b8cd0b357bc7904a948c986b2fa3b39.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

notes.title: Limited Event: "Snowball Fight" Released! Hit Snowballs!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/afa309bbc2685ba6a076219765310c3b38f441d3.png
Now you can play "Snowball Fight" in the world of Toram Online for a limited period of time after the maintenance 2/17/2022!
Use and exchange the "Snowball Points" you get from "Snowball Fight" for rare items that are exclusive to this event!

Make sure to play it with your jolly good friends or guild members and enjoy the exciting game!

"Snowball Fight" Event Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/17/2022
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/14/2022

What is Snowball Fight?
Players are divided into 2 teams and compete the number of snowballs they hit within 3 minutes.

Tips for Snowball Fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/c5530aeeb580a16e671864951646ea2a30e586b4.png
You can access the mini-game venue from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Go to snowball fight venue" at Save Point.

Also, you can go to Save Point from "Menu" > "Terminal" > "Back to Town" from the mini-game venue.

Overview
[olist]
 Tap "I'm ready!!" after moving to the snowball fight field.
 The game will start with selected players via auto-matching.
 The winner is the team that holds more HP than the other.　Snowball Points will increase a little and you will get 1 Ice & Snow Bucket if you win.
[/olist]
*You cannot get the item if your bag is full.
*"Snow Bear Box" that you can get from Prize Exchange has a low chance to appear too from "Ice & Snow Bucket".

Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/76f45b1a60e3e3ec8f76b67b7c2722579431dba1.png
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]HP[/th]
        [td]It decreases if you are hit by opponents.Blue HP shows allied team's HP, red shows opponent team's HP.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Make[/th]
        [td]You can sit down and create snowballs.The more you hold snowballs, the longer it takes to create a snowball.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Throw[/th]
        [td]You can throw a snowball.Snowballs are thrown toward the "+" mark in front of the screen.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Auto[/th]
        [td]You can throw a snowball to a player within the range and sight.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Dodge[/th]
        [td]You can dodge snowballs by quickly moving a short distance.If you are holding snowballs, you may lose them.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
* All throwing motions will become slower if you are in the enemy's zone.

Snowball Fight Becomes Even More Thrilling with the Addition of New Elements?! Use the Item Well!
Treasure Boxes Appear on the Snowball Fight Field!!
You can get a "30-second Buff Item" by tapping the treasure box that appears on the Snowball Fight field!

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Item[/th]
        [th]Buff[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Ice Meteor[/th]
        [td]Ice chunks fall if you place a snowball on the ground![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Ice Barrier[/th]
        [td]No frostbite for up to 3 hits![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Team Rescue[/th]
        [td]Fully recover from frostbite.Team HP restored![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Jumbo Ball[/th]
        [td]Snowballs become bigger![/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [th]Triple[/th]
        [td]Snowballs thrown become 3![/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 
Also, you can steal the buff from knocking down a buffed player!

Have fun using the items and use of them well to lead your team to victory!!

About Frostbite and Respawn
If you get hit by a snowball, you will flinch and get frostbite that causes the screen to freeze for a little bit. If you get another hit in this condition, you will tumble and the screen will continue to freeze. Furthermore, if you get a third hit, you will freeze to death. After the death animation is shown, you will be taken back to the starting point and you lose 200 HP.

You will heal or return to the previous stage of frostbite if you don't get hit for 12 seconds.
You will be invincible for a few seconds when you flinch or tumble.

Exchange Your "Snowball Points" for Various Gorgeous Items!
You can exchange the "Snowball Points" you get from Snowball Fight for items at the Event Prize Exchange.

There are items you can get according to the total "Snowball Points" you have earned so far, and there are also items you can get by simply exchanging the number of "Snowball Points" required.

The exchangeable items include event-limited equipment items and various Orb items.

Get gorgeous items by actively joining the snowball fight!

"Snowball Fight" Event Prize Exchange Available Period
From: After the maintenance on 2/17/2022
Until: Before the maintenance on 4/21/2022

Snowball Fight Limited Special Daily Emblems Available!

Win the snowball fight and get gorgeous items every day!

*You can claim and receive emblems after clearing the conditions from [Menu > News > You've got Emblem].

Notes

*The battle begins after all the party members tap "I'm ready!!".
*The snowballs made during the previous match cannot be used.

*Ranking based on the number of snowball you threw does not affect your win or loss.
*You will not be able to tap a new treasure box to get an additional buff when you still have a buff that is active.
*If you knock down a buffed player from the opponent's team while having an active buff, the buff stolen from the player will be granted to one of your team members.
However, if all players in your team already have a buff that is active, the stolen buff will disappear.

notes.title: About Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign
notes.content:
This is an announcement from Toram Online's Operation Team about Free Skill & Stats Reset Campaign.

During the period below, skill reset and stats reset will be available for free and players will be exempt from paying Spinas when acquiring skills.

Don't miss this chance!!

Available Period
From: 02/17/2022 after the maintenance
Until: 02/24/2022 before the maintenance

The Number of Resets Available
The number of resets available = no. of character slots owned (as of 2/17/2022 before the maintenance) x 1
It does not matter if a character has not been created in the slot as long as you own it.

Ex: If you own 10 character slots, you may reset skills and stats as many as 10 times in total.

How to Reset
Each reset can be done as follows.

For Skills
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu" > "Character" > "Skills"

To reset all skill trees, tap "Reset Skill Trees" then "Reset for Free".

To reset skill trees one by one, tap the skill you would like to reset and tap "Reset" at the bottom right, then tap "Reset for Free".

For Stats
From the top left of the screen, tap "Menu"> "Character" > "Stats" > "Build Character" > "Reset"

For normal stats like STR and INT, choose "Reset Stats" and tap "Reset for Free".

For personal stats like TEC and LUK, choose "Reset Personal Stat" and tap "Reset for Free".

Notes
*You may have to wait for your turn to use the free skill reset due to load balancing.
　In that case, please "Retry" after a while.
*Free resets will be used first if you own items that reset skill or stats such as Book of Oblivion and Reset Book.
　Please note that you are unable to choose either to use the items you own or the free resets.
*Resetting either all skill trees or resetting the skill trees one by one will be counted as "1" reset.
*Resetting either normal stats like STR and INT or personal stat will be counted as "1" reset.
*Please note that after deleting a skill tree, you'll need items or Spinas to learn the skills.
*Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.

Please spend your Valentine's Day with Toram Online too!

Valentine's Day Event Period
From: 02/10/2022 after maintenance

Collect the Ingredients and Make the special "Heart Chocolate" for your One 'n Only!!
Let's Collect "Red Wrapping Ribbons"!

During the event period, you can create "Heart Chocolate" by collecting the "Red Wrapping Ribbons" obtainable from all monsters and bringing them to the synthesist.
"Heart Chocolate" has a healing effect and can also be used by the creator.

Furthermore, "Heart Chocolate" can be produced with Alchemy Skills.

Let's Trade "Heart Chocolate"!
If you trade "Heart Chocolate" during the event period with another adventurer, it will become an untradeable item and its HP healing effect will increase by 10 times.

Also, the name of the creator will be shown in the item description, making it a special gift that is just right for Valentine's Day.

Give it directly to the one and only important person of yours with love!

Notes
*You cannot obtain "Red Wrapping Ribbon" from special event maps such as Guild Maze or Challenge Dungeon.
*The creator's name of the "Heart Chocolate" will be displayed only when it is traded during the event period.
"Heart Chocolate"'s HP healing effect increases only when it is traded during the event period.
The aforementioned changes will not apply to the "Heart Chocolate" when sent via gift or sold with the Consignment system.

Let's Make the Event-Limited Monster Your Pet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/03cc2ed7463b53741fe333b81accea1ae424b9ef.png
Certain monsters that inhabit the event-limited map can also be tamed and captured with Tamer Skills.

Some monsters can only be found here, so if you see any monster that you like, try to capture it!

How to Capture a Pet
To capture monsters, you need to have empty Consumable Item: "Pet Cage"(*1), and learn Tamer Skill: "Taming"(*2).
By using "Taming" on the monsters that can be captured while meeting the conditions above, the time limit will be displayed.
Capture will be completed when the green bar reaches to max within the time limit.
If the green bar didn't reach to max within the time limit, the capture fails and you may lose a Pet Cage.

*1 You can buy "Pet Cage" at general stores in cities.
*2 You can learn Tamer Skills at the library in Sofya City by paying Spina.
Lv1 Tamer Skills are available from Lv30, Lv2 Tamer Skills from Lv90.

Notes
*The event period and rewards are subject to change.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:January  28th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:January  31st at 12:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)

What is a Guild Maze?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/b5f46a3e6021cc4dee6abe4f4be862fceb593aaa.png
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.

notes.title: [Limited Time Only] Treasure Hunting in Guild Maze!!
notes.content:
3x appearance rates of "Treasure Boxes" in Guild Maze during the following period!
Now's your chance to get rare items that can be obtained only in Guild Maze!

But be careful, the appearance rates of traps are also boosted.

Event Period
From:November  24th at 6:30 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until:November  27th at  before the maintenance

What is a Guild Maze?
Guild Maze is a special dungeon that you can enter from the "Guild Bar" that is unlocked when your guild reaches Lv10.
The Guild Maze has 1000 stories with monsters and traps that are blocking the adventurers' way. Powerful bosses will also appear on certain floors.
For your information, there are also many items that can only be obtained from the maze.
Here, you can enjoy a thrilling adventure that goes hand in hand with danger.

Challenge and try to conquer it with your guild mates!

The progress is reset on the first of every month at 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) and you can explore the maze again from the first floor.

Note
*The contents of the Treasure Boxes will not change.
*You can get the event buffs if you enter the Guild Maze after the event time starts.
*Please note that as the progress needs to be reset, you will be unable to enter the Guild Maze for about 1 hour from 12:00 AM (JST/GMT+9) on the first of every month.
